def secondary_bottom_right(width, height, margin=12):
    """Fallback: other monitor (or primary if alone), bottom-right."""
    app = QApplication.instance()
    screens = app.screens() if app else []
    if not screens:
        return 20, 20
    primary = app.primaryScreen() if app else None
    target = None
    for s in screens:
        if primary is None or s is not primary:
            target = s
            break
    if target is None:
        target = primary or screens[0]
    g = target.availableGeometry()
    x = g.x() + g.width() - width - margin
    y = g.y() + g.height() - height - margin
    return int(x), int(y)

    """ACS OSD/HUD position (same file ACS_HUD.pyw writes)."""
    try:
        with open(ACS_HUD_POS_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
            d = json.load(f)
            return int(d["x"]), int(d["y"]), ACS_HUD_W, ACS_HUD_H
    except Exception:
        x, y = secondary_bottom_right(ACS_HUD_W, ACS_HUD_H)

    screen = (app.primaryScreen() if app else None)

    g = screen.availableGeometry()

scripts.content:
import sys
import os
import pythoncom
import win32com.client

TRIGGER_PHRASE = "reboot PC"
SCRIPT_TO_RUN = r"~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station\_System_Core\Active Scripts\AHK Scripts\Reboot\VOICE_REBOOT.ahk"

class SpeechEventHandler:
    def OnRecognition(self, StreamNumber, StreamPosition, RecognitionType, Result):
        recognized_text = Result.PhraseInfo.GetText()
        if recognized_text.lower() == TRIGGER_PHRASE.lower():
            os.startfile(SCRIPT_TO_RUN)
            sys.exit(0)

def main():
    recognizer = win32com.client.Dispatch("SAPI.SpSharedRecognizer")
    context = recognizer.CreateRecoContext()
    win32com.client.WithEvents(context, SpeechEventHandler)
    grammar = context.CreateGrammar(1)
    rule = grammar.Rules.Add("RebootRule", 33, 1)
    rule.InitialState.AddWordTransition(None, TRIGGER_PHRASE)
    grammar.Rules.Commit()
    grammar.CmdSetRuleState("RebootRule", 1)
    pythoncom.PumpMessages()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

scripts.content:
#NoEnv
SendMode Input
SetWorkingDir %A_ScriptDir%
#SingleInstance Force

; ==============================================================================
; 1. Control Volume with Mouse
; Hover over the Taskbar and scroll the mouse wheel up/down to adjust volume.
; Middle click the taskbar to mute/unmute.
; ==============================================================================
#If MouseIsOver("ahk_class Shell_TrayWnd")
WheelUp::Send {Volume_Up}
WheelDown::Send {Volume_Down}
MButton::Send {Volume_Mute}
#If

MouseIsOver(WinTitle) {
    MouseGetPos,,, Win
    return WinExist(WinTitle . " ahk_id " . Win)
}

; ==============================================================================
; 2. Left and Right arrows together for Screenshot
; ==============================================================================
~Left & Right::
~Right & Left::
    Gui, Scrn:Destroy
    Gui, Scrn:New, +AlwaysOnTop -MaximizeBox -MinimizeBox, Screenshot
    Gui, Scrn:Add, Text,, Select Monitor for Screenshot:
    SysGet, MonCount, MonitorCount
    Loop, %MonCount%
    {
        Gui, Scrn:Add, Button, gTakeScreenshot w150, Monitor %A_Index%
    }
    Gui, Scrn:Show, AutoSize Center
return

TakeScreenshot:
    Gui, Scrn:Submit
    Gui, Scrn:Destroy
    MonitorNum := RegExReplace(A_GuiControl, "\D") ; Extract number from button
    
    ; Get monitor coordinates
    SysGet, Mon, Monitor, %MonitorNum%
    Width := MonRight - MonLeft
    Height := MonBottom - MonTop
    
    ; Take screenshot using ffmpeg
    OutDir := A_Desktop . "\Screen Recordings"
    IfNotExist, %OutDir%
        FileCreateDir, %OutDir%
    OutFile := OutDir . "\Screenshot_" . A_Now . ".png"
    Run, cmd.exe /c "ffmpeg -y -f gdigrab -offset_x %MonLeft% -offset_y %MonTop% -video_size %Width%x%Height% -i desktop -vframes 1 ""%OutFile%""", , Hide
    
    Sleep 1000
    MsgBox, 64, Screenshot, Saved screenshot of Monitor %MonitorNum% to Desktop.
return

ScrnGuiClose:
ScrnGuiEscape:
    Gui, Scrn:Destroy
return

; ==============================================================================
; 3. Up and Down arrows together for Video Recording (Using NVIDIA PCI GPU)
; ==============================================================================
~Up & Down::
~Down & Up::
    Gui, Rec:Destroy
    Gui, Rec:New, +AlwaysOnTop -MaximizeBox -MinimizeBox, Record Video
    Gui, Rec:Add, Text,, Select Monitor for Recording:
    SysGet, MonCount, MonitorCount
    Loop, %MonCount%
    {
        Gui, Rec:Add, Button, gRecordVideo w150, Monitor %A_Index%
    }
    Gui, Rec:Show, AutoSize Center
return

RecordVideo:
    Gui, Rec:Submit
    Gui, Rec:Destroy
    MonitorNum := RegExReplace(A_GuiControl, "\D")
    
    ; Get monitor coordinates
    SysGet, Mon, Monitor, %MonitorNum%
    Width := MonRight - MonLeft
    Height := MonBottom - MonTop
    
    ; Record video using ffmpeg with h264_nvenc (NVIDIA PCI GPU)
    OutDir := A_Desktop . "\Screen Recordings"
    IfNotExist, %OutDir%
        FileCreateDir, %OutDir%
    OutFile := OutDir . "\Recording_" . A_Now . ".mp4"
    Run, cmd.exe /c "echo Press 'q' in this window to stop recording && ffmpeg -y -f gdigrab -offset_x %MonLeft% -offset_y %MonTop% -video_size %Width%x%Height% -framerate 60 -i desktop -c:v h264_nvenc -preset p6 -tune hq -b:v 15M -bufsize 15M -pix_fmt yuv420p ""%OutFile%"""
return

RecGuiClose:
RecGuiEscape:
    Gui, Rec:Destroy
return

; ==============================================================================
; 4. Pause Playtorio in the Background
; ==============================================================================
; I highly recommend using Alt + Space (written as !Space in AutoHotkey) 
; because if you just use the Spacebar by itself, every time you type a space 
; in an email or chat, it will pause/play your video in the background!
!Space::
    ; This looks for any window that has "playtorio" anywhere in the title
    SetTitleMatchMode, 2 
    ; Sends the Spacebar directly to that background window
    ControlSend,, {Space}, playtorio
return

"""
Brianna Windows ears — fast mic path (AC-hum + TV aware).

Design goals:

scripts.content:
"""
Brianna Windows ears — fast mic path (AC-hum + TV aware).

Design goals:
  - Capture loop must NEVER block on Whisper or the gateway (that was the lag).
  - Steady AC hum handled by high-pass + speech-band VAD.
  - TV dialogue reduced via loopback correlation gate (no heavy per-sample AEC).
  - Worker thread: transcribe + POST /heard.

Usage:
  python brianna-ears-win.py
  python brianna-ears-win.py --once
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import queue
import re
import sys
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

import numpy as np

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
LOG = os.path.join(BASE, "logs", "brianna-ears-win.log")
HEARD_FILE = os.path.join(BASE, "last_heard.txt")
PID_FILE = os.path.join(BASE, "brianna-ears-win.pid")
PTT_ARM_FILE = os.path.join(BASE, "ptt-arm.json")
SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
CAPTURE_RATE = 48000
FRAME = 960  # 20 ms @ 48 kHz
GATEWAY = "http://127.0.0.1:8090"


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    line = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") + " " + str(msg)
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(LOG), exist_ok=True)
        with open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(line + "\n")
    except Exception:
        pass
    print(line, flush=True)


def gateway_base() -> str:
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(BASE, "brianna-gateway.json"), "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
            cfg = json.load(f)
        return "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(cfg["gateway"]["port"])
    except Exception:
        return GATEWAY


def write_heard(text: str) -> None:
    try:
        with open(HEARD_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write((text or "").strip())
    except Exception:
        pass


def post_heard(text: str) -> dict:
    url = gateway_base().rstrip("/") + "/heard"
    body = json.dumps({"t": "final", "text": text, "conf": 0.9, "source": "win-aec"}).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    # Keep timeout finite so a hung LLM can't stall the worker forever
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            try:
                return json.loads(raw)
            except Exception:
                return {"ok": True, "raw": raw}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"HTTP {e.code}: {e.read()[:200]}"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(e)}


# Always listen on the Amazon USB Streaming Mic — never silently fall back.
AMAZON_MIC_NAME_HINTS = (
    "amazon usb streaming mic",
    "amazon usb",
    "amazon",
)


def _mic_score(name: str) -> int:
    nl = (name or "").lower()
    score = 0
    if "amazon usb streaming mic" in nl:
        score += 100
    if "amazon" in nl and "mic" in nl:
        score += 80
    if "amazon" in nl:
        score += 50
    if "2-" in nl and "amazon" in nl:
        score += 10
    if "usb" in nl and "mic" in nl and "steam" not in nl and "oculus" not in nl:
        score += 5
    # Hard rejects for virtual/other mics
    if any(x in nl for x in ("steam", "oculus", "virtual", "relay", "avnex", "stereo mix")):
        score -= 200
    return score


def find_devices():
    import pyaudiowpatch as pyaudio

    p = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    wasapi_index = None
    try:
        wasapi_index = p.get_host_api_info_by_type(pyaudio.paWASAPI)["index"]
    except Exception:
        pass

    mic_idx = None
    loop_idx = None
    default_out_name = ""
    try:
        default_out_name = p.get_default_output_device_info().get("name") or ""
    except Exception:
        default_out_name = ""

    mics = []
    loops = []
    for i in range(p.get_device_count()):
        info = p.get_device_info_by_index(i)
        if wasapi_index is not None and info.get("hostApi") != wasapi_index:
            continue
        name = str(info.get("name") or "")
        if info.get("maxInputChannels", 0) > 0:
            if info.get("isLoopbackDevice"):
                loops.append((i, name, info))
            else:
                mics.append((i, name, info))

    # Rank Amazon first. Do NOT fall back to a non-Amazon mic unless forced.
    ranked = sorted(
        (( _mic_score(name), i, name, info) for i, name, info in mics),
        key=lambda x: x[0],
        reverse=True,
    )
    force_any = str(os.environ.get("DK_EARS_ALLOW_ANY_MIC", "") or "").strip() in {"1", "true", "yes"}
    if ranked and ranked[0][0] > 0:
        mic_idx = ranked[0][1]
        log(f"mic lock: selected Amazon-class device score={ranked[0][0]} name={ranked[0][2]}")
    elif ranked and force_any:
        mic_idx = ranked[0][1]
        log(f"WARNING: Amazon mic not found; DK_EARS_ALLOW_ANY_MIC using {ranked[0][2]}")
    else:
        available = ", ".join(n for _, n, _ in mics) or "(none)"
        log(f"ERROR: Amazon USB Streaming Mic not found among WASAPI inputs: {available}")
        mic_idx = None

    out_l = default_out_name.lower()
    for i, name, info in loops:
        nl = name.lower()
        if "lg tv" in nl or (out_l and out_l[:12] in nl):
            loop_idx = i
            break
    if loop_idx is None:
        for i, name, info in loops:
            if "nvidia" in name.lower() or "lg" in name.lower():
                loop_idx = i
                break
    if loop_idx is None and loops:
        loop_idx = loops[0][0]

    mic_name = next((n for i, n, _ in mics if i == mic_idx), "?")
    loop_name = next((n for i, n, _ in loops if i == loop_idx), "?")
    return p, mic_idx, loop_idx, mic_name, loop_name, default_out_name


def load_whisper():
    from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

    size = os.environ.get("DK_WHISPER_MODEL", "base.en")
    log(f"loading whisper {size} (cpu int8)...")
    model = WhisperModel(size, device="cpu", compute_type="int8", cpu_threads=4)
    log("whisper ready")
    return model


# STT repair for Dell player voice macros. Do NOT auto-play shows from bare
# title noise — that was launching Family Guy over and over and blocking seeks.
_COMMAND_SALVAGE = [
    # Player seek macros (common Whisper mishears)
    (r"\b(sick|seek|sic|sig|seak|sheik|chic|cheek)\s*(one|1|won)\b", "seek one"),
    (r"\b(sick|seek|sic|sig|seak|sheik|chic|cheek)\s*(two|2|to|too|too)\b", "seek two"),
    (r"\blong\s*(sick|seek|sic|skip|seak)\s*(one|1|won)\b", "long skip one"),
    (r"\blong\s*(sick|seek|sic|skip|seak)\s*(two|2|to|too)\b", "long skip two"),
    (r"\b(skip|ship|skit)\s*(one|1|won)\b", "skip one"),
    (r"\b(skip|ship|skit)\s*(two|2|to|too)\b", "skip two"),
    (r"\b(back|bac)\s*(one|1|won)\b", "back one"),
    (r"\b(back|bac)\s*(two|2|to|too)\b", "back two"),
    (r"\b(next)\s*(two|2|to|too)\b", "next two"),
    (r"\b(next)\s*(one|1|won)\b", "next one"),
    (r"\b(pause|paused|paws)\s*(one|1|won)\b", "pause one"),
    (r"\b(pause|paused|paws)\s*(two|2|to|too)\b", "pause two"),
    (r"\b(play|resume)\s*(one|1|won)\b", "resume one"),
    (r"\b(play|resume)\s*(two|2|to|too)\b", "resume two"),
    # Exit continuous seek — STT often mangles these while video is loud

import speech_recognition as sr
import time
import subprocess
import os
import cv2
import tempfile
import winsound

# --- CONFIGURATION ---
IP_WEBCAM_URL = "http://192.168.1.XX:8080/video"

KOKORO_CLI = r"~\Desktop\DK_Command_Center\Library\04_Voice_AI_Dictation\Voice_Station\Kokoro\.venv\Scripts\kokoro-tts.exe"
KOKORO_MODEL = r"~\Desktop\DK_Command_Center\Library\04_Voice_AI_Dictation\Voice_Station\Kokoro\models\kokoro-v1.0.onnx"
KOKORO_VOICES = r"~\Desktop\DK_Command_Center\Library\04_Voice_AI_Dictation\Voice_Station\Kokoro\models\voices-v1.0.bin"
KOKORO_VOICE_NAME = "af_heart" # Using AF Heart!

def speak(text):
    """Speaks the given text out loud using Kokoro TTS."""
    print(f"🤖 [{KOKORO_VOICE_NAME}]: {text}")
    try:
        fd_txt, txt_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".txt")
        fd_wav, wav_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".wav")
        os.close(fd_txt)
        os.close(fd_wav)
        
        with open(txt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)
            
        cmd = [
            KOKORO_CLI,
            txt_path,
            wav_path,
            "--model", KOKORO_MODEL,
            "--voices", KOKORO_VOICES,
            "--voice", KOKORO_VOICE_NAME,
            "--speed", "1.0"
        ]
        
        # Run Kokoro CLI to generate the WAV file
        subprocess.run(cmd, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        
        # Play the WAV file natively
        if os.path.exists(wav_path):
            winsound.PlaySound(wav_path, winsound.SND_FILENAME)
            
        # Cleanup
        os.remove(txt_path)
        os.remove(wav_path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Kokoro TTS error: {e}")

def capture_frame(save_filename="vision_capture.jpg"):
    if "XX" in IP_WEBCAM_URL:
        speak("Please update the IP webcam URL in the script first.")
        return None
        
    print(f"📷 Connecting to camera at {IP_WEBCAM_URL}...")
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(IP_WEBCAM_URL)
    
    if not cap.isOpened():
        speak("Could not connect to the Android camera.")
        return None
        
    ret, frame = cap.read()
    cap.release()
    
    if ret:
        cv2.imwrite(save_filename, frame)
        return save_filename
    return None

def trigger_fun_time():
    speak("Starting fun time now.")
    print("🎬 -> Media player launched (Placeholder)")

def handle_vision_query(text):
    if "who is here" in text or "who is this" in text:
        speak("Let me take a look.")
        frame_path = capture_frame("latest_face.jpg")
        if frame_path:
            speak("I see someone, but facial recognition is still booting up.")
            
    elif "what am i holding" in text or "look at this" in text:
        speak("Snapping a picture now.")
        frame_path = capture_frame(f"item_capture_{int(time.time())}.jpg")
        if frame_path:
            speak("Picture taken. I am sending it to my brain.")

def listen_for_commands():
    recognizer = sr.Recognizer()
    microphone = sr.Microphone()

    with microphone as source:
        print("Calibrating for background noise... please wait.")
        recognizer.adjust_for_ambient_noise(source, duration=2)
        print(f"\n✅ Ready! Say 'fun time'. Kokoro ({KOKORO_VOICE_NAME}) is active.")
        speak("Voice macros are now active.")

    while True:
        try:
            with microphone as source:
                print("\nListening...")
                audio = recognizer.listen(source, timeout=5, phrase_time_limit=5)
                
            print("Processing speech...")
            text = recognizer.recognize_google(audio).lower()
            print(f"🗣️ You said: '{text}'")
            
            if "fun time" in text:
                trigger_fun_time()
            elif "who" in text or "what am i holding" in text or "look" in text:
                handle_vision_query(text)
            elif "exit macro" in text or "stop listening" in text:
                speak("Shutting down voice macros. Goodbye!")
                break
                
        except sr.WaitTimeoutError:
            pass 
        except sr.UnknownValueError:
            pass
        except sr.RequestError as e:
            pass
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            break

if __name__ == "__main__":
    listen_for_commands()

import os
import time
import winsound
from core.cloner import KokoClone

INPUT_FILE = r"~\DK_AI_Media\agent_tts_input.txt"
OUTPUT_FILE = r"~\DK_AI_Media\agent_tts_output.wav"

def main():
    print("Loading KokoClone for automated Agent TTS...")
    cloner = KokoClone()
    print("KokoClone loaded. Waiting for agent messages...")

    # Ensure the directory exists
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(INPUT_FILE), exist_ok=True)
    
    # Create the file if it doesn't exist so we can watch its modified time
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
        with open(INPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write("")

    last_mtime = os.path.getmtime(INPUT_FILE)

    while True:
        time.sleep(1)
        current_mtime = os.path.getmtime(INPUT_FILE)
        if current_mtime != last_mtime:
            last_mtime = current_mtime
            
            with open(INPUT_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                text = f.read().strip()
                
            if text:
                print(f"Generating TTS for new message: {text[:50]}...")
                try:
                    # You can change 'en' to your preferred language and add a reference_audio if you want voice cloning!
                    cloner.generate(
                        text=text,
                        lang="en",
                        reference_audio="reference.wav" if os.path.exists("reference.wav") else None,
                        output_path=OUTPUT_FILE
                    )
                    # Play the generated audio
                    winsound.PlaySound(OUTPUT_FILE, winsound.SND_FILENAME)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Error generating or playing TTS: {e}")
                print("Finished speaking. Waiting for next message...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

scripts.preview:
@echo off
rem ============================================================
rem  Kokoro TTS - One-Click Launcher (RTX 4060 GPU, native)
rem  - Starts Kokoro-FastAPI on port 8880 silently/minimized
rem  - Prevents duplicate instances (exits if already running)
scripts.content:
@echo off
rem ============================================================
rem  Kokoro TTS - One-Click Launcher (RTX 4060 GPU, native)
rem  - Starts Kokoro-FastAPI on port 8880 silently/minimized
rem  - Prevents duplicate instances (exits if already running)
rem  - Logs to kf_server.log next to this file's repo root
rem ============================================================
setlocal EnableExtensions

set "BASE=~\Kokoro-FastAPI"
set "PORT=8880"
set "LOG=%BASE%\kf_server.log"

rem ---- Duplicate-instance guard: is port 8880 already listening? ----
netstat -ano | findstr /c:":%PORT% " | findstr /c:"LISTENING" >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel%==0 (
    echo Kokoro TTS is already running on port %PORT%. Nothing to do.
    timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul
    exit /b 0
)

rem ---- Environment for the server ----
cd /d "%BASE%"
set "PROJECT_ROOT=%BASE%"
set "PYTHONPATH=%BASE%;%BASE%\api"
set "MODEL_DIR=%BASE%\api\src\models"
set "VOICES_DIR=%BASE%\api\src\voices\v1_0"
set "WEB_PLAYER_PATH=%BASE%\web"
set "USE_GPU=true"
set "PYTHONUTF8=1"

rem ---- Launch uvicorn hidden (inherits env above), log to file ----
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Process -FilePath '%BASE%\.venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe' -ArgumentList 'api.src.main:app','--host','0.0.0.0','--port','%PORT%' -WorkingDirectory '%BASE%' -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput '%LOG%' -RedirectStandardError '%BASE%\kf_server.err'"

echo Kokoro TTS starting on http://localhost:%PORT%  (GPU: RTX 4060)
exit /b 0

from pathlib import Path

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication, QWidget, QColorDialog, QSystemTrayIcon, QMenu, QDialog,
    QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QLabel, QLineEdit, QDateTimeEdit,
    QTimeEdit, QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QMessageBox, QTabWidget,

from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QPainter, QColor, QPen, QFont, QBrush, QConicalGradient, QRadialGradient,
    QLinearGradient, QPolygon, QPolygonF, QAction, QCursor, QIcon, QPixmap, QRegion
)

APP_NAME = "Nexus Wallpaper Clock Lite"

# Keep runtime state out of Desktop. The old Desktop state is read once during
# migration so existing clock positions survive this repair.
STATE_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", str(Path.home() / "AppData" / "Local"))) / "DKNexus" / "WallClock"
LEGACY_STATE_DIR = Path(r"~\Desktop\Active Scripts\Python Scripts\Wall clock")
ACS_DIR = Path(r"~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station\_System_Core\Active Scripts\Python Scripts\Wall clock")
# Runtime dir = where this file lives (deps like OSD_SYSTEM.py).
RUNTIME_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
CANONICAL_DIR = STATE_DIR
CONFIG_FILE = STATE_DIR / "Nexus_Wallpaper_Clock_config.json"
PLACEMENT_FILE = STATE_DIR / "wall_clock_placement.json"
LOG_FILE = STATE_DIR / "wall_clock_debug.log"
MUTEX_NAME = r"Local\NexusWallpaperWallClock_SingleInstance_v1"
_MUTEX_HANDLE = None

# Lite mode deliberately does not import OSD_SYSTEM. CPU/RAM, payday, days-off,
# and work-time readouts are painted directly on the clock face and remain.

    _map_import_err_saved = _map_import_err
else:
    _map_import_err_saved = None

def clamp(n, lo, hi):
    return max(lo, min(hi, n))

def color_with_alpha(color, alpha):
    c = QColor(color)
    c.setAlpha(int(clamp(alpha, 0, 255)))
    return c

def make_pen(color, width=1.0):
    """Create a rounded QPen safely from a QColor, QBrush, gradient, or pen.

    PyQt6 is picky about QPen constructor overloads. Passing a gradient
    or QBrush directly into QPen can throw TypeError, so this builds an
    empty pen first and then applies the brush/color.
    """
    try:
        if isinstance(color, QPen):
            pen = QPen(color)
        else:
            pen = QPen()
            if isinstance(color, QBrush):
                pen.setBrush(color)
            elif isinstance(color, (QLinearGradient, QConicalGradient, QRadialGradient)):
                pen.setBrush(QBrush(color))
            elif isinstance(color, QColor):
                pen.setColor(color)
            else:
                pen.setColor(QColor(color))

        pen.setWidthF(float(width))
        pen.setStyle(Qt.PenStyle.SolidLine)
        pen.setCapStyle(Qt.PenCapStyle.RoundCap)
        pen.setJoinStyle(Qt.PenJoinStyle.RoundJoin)
        return pen
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"make_pen fallback used for {type(color).__name__}: {e}")
        pen = QPen(QColor(0, 212, 255))
        pen.setWidthF(float(width))
        pen.setCapStyle(Qt.PenCapStyle.RoundCap)
        pen.setJoinStyle(Qt.PenJoinStyle.RoundJoin)
        return pen

def log(msg):
    try:
        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        LOG_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with LOG_FILE.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"[{stamp}] {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def acquire_single_instance_mutex():
    """Ensure only one WALL_CLOCK process runs (Windows named mutex)."""
    global _MUTEX_HANDLE
    if os.name != "nt":
        return True
    try:
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        handle = kernel32.CreateMutexW(None, False, MUTEX_NAME)
        if not handle:
            log("single-instance mutex: CreateMutex failed; continuing cautiously")
            return True
        last_error = kernel32.GetLastError()
        ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS = 183
        if last_error == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS:
            kernel32.CloseHandle(handle)
            log("single-instance mutex: another WALL_CLOCK instance owns the lock")
            return False
        _MUTEX_HANDLE = handle
        log(f"single-instance mutex acquired: {MUTEX_NAME}")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"single-instance mutex error: {e}")
        return True


def release_single_instance_mutex():
    global _MUTEX_HANDLE
    if os.name != "nt" or not _MUTEX_HANDLE:
        return
    try:
        ctypes.windll.kernel32.CloseHandle(_MUTEX_HANDLE)
    except Exception:
        pass
    _MUTEX_HANDLE = None

    try:

import acs_adb_controller

        os.remove(screenshot)

if __name__ == "__main__":

scripts.content:
import cv2
import pytesseract
import os
from pytesseract import Output

# Assuming Tesseract is installed at the default location. If not, update this path.
pytesseract.pytesseract.tesseract_cmd = r'C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR\tesseract.exe'

def find_text_coordinates(image_path, target_text, threshold=60):
    """
    Search for target_text in the image using Tesseract OCR.
    Returns (x, y) center coordinates of the found text, or None if not found.
    """
    if not os.path.exists(image_path):
        print(f"Error: Image {image_path} not found.")
        return None

    img = cv2.imread(image_path)
    if img is None:
        print(f"Error: Could not load image {image_path}")
        return None

    # Convert to grayscale for better OCR
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    
    # Get OCR output with bounding boxes
    d = pytesseract.image_to_data(gray, output_type=Output.DICT)
    
    n_boxes = len(d['text'])
    for i in range(n_boxes):
        if int(d['conf'][i]) > threshold:

scripts.content:
import subprocess
import time
import os

ADB_PATH = r"C:\adb\adb.exe"

def run_adb_command(command):
    """Run an ADB command and return its output."""
    full_cmd = f'"{ADB_PATH}" {command}'
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(full_cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        return result.stdout.strip()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error running adb command: {e}")
        return None

def tap(x, y):
    """Tap at specific x, y coordinates on the screen."""
    print(f"Tapping at ({x}, {y})")
    run_adb_command(f"shell input tap {x} {y}")

def swipe(x1, y1, x2, y2, duration=500):
    """Swipe from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2) over 'duration' milliseconds."""
    print(f"Swiping from ({x1}, {y1}) to ({x2}, {y2}) over {duration}ms")
    run_adb_command(f"shell input swipe {x1} {y1} {x2} {y2} {duration}")

def input_text(text):
    """Input text to the device."""
    # Replace spaces with %s for adb shell input text
    text = text.replace(' ', '%s')
    print(f"Typing text: {text}")
    run_adb_command(f"shell input text '{text}'")

def pull_screenshot(destination_path="screenshot.png"):
    """Take a screenshot on the device and pull it to the local machine."""
    run_adb_command("shell screencap -p /sdcard/screencap.png")
    run_adb_command(f"pull /sdcard/screencap.png {destination_path}")
    return destination_path

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("Testing ADB connection...")
    devices = run_adb_command("devices")
    print(devices)

import time, numpy as np
import pyaudiowpatch as pyaudio
p = pyaudio.PyAudio()
wasapi = p.get_host_api_info_by_type(pyaudio.paWASAPI)["index"]
print("default in:", p.get_default_input_device_info().get("name"))
print("default out:", p.get_default_output_device_info().get("name"))
mics=[]; loops=[]
for i in range(p.get_device_count()):
    info=p.get_device_info_by_index(i)
    if info.get("hostApi")!=wasapi: continue
    if info.get("maxInputChannels",0)<=0: continue
    name=str(info.get("name") or "")
    if info.get("isLoopbackDevice"):
        loops.append((i,name,info))
    else:
        mics.append((i,name,info))
for i,n,info in mics:
    print("MIC", i, n, "ch", info["maxInputChannels"], "rate", int(info.get("defaultSampleRate",0)))
for i,n,info in loops:
    print("LOOP", i, n)
mic_idx=next((i for i,n,_ in mics if "amazon" in n.lower()), mics[0][0] if mics else None)
loop_idx=next((i for i,n,_ in loops if "lg" in n.lower()), None)
print("use", mic_idx, loop_idx)
RATE=48000; FRAME=960
mic_ch=min(2,int(p.get_device_info_by_index(mic_idx)["maxInputChannels"]))
loop_ch=min(2,int(p.get_device_info_by_index(loop_idx)["maxInputChannels"])) if loop_idx is not None else 0

def mono(raw, ch):
    x=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768.0
    if ch>1:
        n=(len(x)//ch)*ch
        x=x[:n].reshape(-1,ch).mean(1)
    return x

ms=p.open(format=pyaudio.paInt16,channels=mic_ch,rate=RATE,input=True,input_device_index=mic_idx,frames_per_buffer=FRAME)
rs=p.open(format=pyaudio.paInt16,channels=loop_ch,rate=RATE,input=True,input_device_index=loop_idx,frames_per_buffer=FRAME) if loop_idx is not None else None
ml=[]; rl=[]
t_end=time.time()+3.0
while time.time()<t_end:
    m=mono(ms.read(FRAME, exception_on_overflow=False), mic_ch)
    ml.append(float(np.mean(np.abs(m))))
    if rs:
        r=mono(rs.read(FRAME, exception_on_overflow=False), loop_ch)
        rl.append(float(np.mean(np.abs(r))))
ms.close()
if rs: rs.close()
p.terminate()
ml=np.array(ml); rl=np.array(rl) if rl else np.zeros(1)
print("mic mean/p50/p95/max", float(ml.mean()), float(np.median(ml)), float(np.percentile(ml,95)), float(ml.max()))
print("ref mean/p50/p95/max", float(rl.mean()), float(np.median(rl)), float(np.percentile(rl,95)), float(rl.max()))

scripts.description: DK NEXUS — hands-free dictation.
scripts.preview:
"""
DK NEXUS — hands-free dictation.

Built to replace Voice Access, whose failure mode was typing things Dell never
said. Three defences against that, in order of importance:
scripts.content:
"""
DK NEXUS — hands-free dictation.

Built to replace Voice Access, whose failure mode was typing things Dell never
said. Three defences against that, in order of importance:

  1. ARMED/DISARMED.  Dictation only types when the arm-flag file exists. Not
     armed = microphone audio is discarded. This is the difference between a
     tool and a hazard.
  2. VAD.  Silero voice-activity detection gates the transcriber, so silence
     and room noise never reach Whisper. Whisper invents words when handed
     near-silence; this is the root cause of phantom typing.
  3. JUNK FILTER.  Even with VAD, Whisper emits known artefacts ("thanks for
     watching", subtitle credits, single syllables). Those are dropped.

Usage:
    python dictate.py            # runs; watches the arm flag
    python dictate.py --once     # transcribe one utterance and print it
"""

import sys
import os
import time
import queue
import re

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def _gateway_base():
    try:
        import json
        with open(os.path.join(BASE, "brianna-gateway.json"), "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
            cfg = json.load(f)
        return "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(cfg["gateway"]["port"])
    except Exception:
        return "http://127.0.0.1:8090"


GATEWAY_BASE = _gateway_base()
ARM_FLAG = os.path.join(BASE, "_dictation_armed")
# Latch: when this file exists, dictation stays on until explicitly stopped.
# A file (not a variable) so the dashboard and your voice flip the same switch.
LATCH_FLAG = os.path.join(BASE, "_dictation_latched")
# Same idea as LATCH_FLAG: presence overrides the configured auto-send default
# to OFF for this session. Absence means "use auto_send_after_silence_sec
# from dictation-phrases.json". A file, again, so voice and the dashboard
# flip the same switch.
AUTOSEND_OFF_FLAG = os.path.join(BASE, "_autosend_off")
LOG = os.path.join(BASE, "dictate.log")

SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
BLOCK = 1600           # 100ms blocks
SILENCE_TAIL = 0.45    # seconds of quiet that ends an utterance. Directly sets
                       # how long you wait for the wake tone — nothing can be
                       # transcribed until we decide you have stopped talking.
MAX_UTTERANCE = 20.0   # hard cap so a stuck stream can't run away

HEARD_FILE = os.path.join(BASE, "last_heard.txt")
HEARD_LOG = os.path.join(BASE, "heard_log.txt")


def write_heard(text):
    """Feeds the on-screen 'Heard:' caption (heard_osd.py).

    This used to be written by DK Voice Commander. That listener was removed
    for fighting over the microphone, so dictation writes the caption now —
    otherwise the OSD would sit there blank forever.
    """
    try:
        t = (text or "").strip()
        if not t:
            return
        with open(HEARD_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(t)
        with open(HEARD_LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") + "\t" + t + "\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def log(msg):
    line = time.strftime("[%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S] ") + msg
    print(line, flush=True)
    try:
        with open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(line + "\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


# Whisper's known silence-hallucinations. Ported from the filters already
# written in PalotVoiceHUD/hud.html — someone had solved this and it was
# never connected to anything.
PHANTOM_PATTERNS = [
    r"\b(subs?|subtitles?|caption(s|ed)?|transcript)\s*(by|from|via|:)",
    r"\b(thanks?|thank you) for watching\b",
    r"\b(please )?subscribe\b",
    r"\blike and subscribe\b",
    r"\bsee you (next time|in the next video)\b",
    r"\b(all rights reserved|music by|lyrics by|transcription by)\b",
    r"(www\.|https?://)",
    r"\bamara\b|\bopensubtitles\b",
]

JUNK_WORDS = {
    "a", "i", "the", "you", "yeah", "yah", "yep", "uh", "um", "hmm", "mm", "mmm",
    "mhm", "ah", "oh", "huh", "okay", "ok", "thanks", "thank you", "hello", "hey",
    "hi", "so", "and", "well", "like", "bye", "to", "of", "in", "it", "is", "this",
    "that", "there", "then", "we", "me", "my", "be", "or", "if", "on", "at", "as",
    "an", "no", "yes", "hm", "erm", "eh", "right", "sure", "you know",
}


def is_junk(text):
    """True if this looks like a hallucination or a meaningless fragment."""
    raw = (text or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return True
    low = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s']", " ", raw.lower())
    low = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", low).strip()
    if len(low) < 3:
        return True
    if low in JUNK_WORDS:
        return True
    for pat in PHANTOM_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pat, raw, re.IGNORECASE):
            return True
    # "the the the", "a a a a" — repetition artefacts from near-silence
    if re.fullmatch(r"((the|a|ah|eh|uh|um|you|so|and|yeah|oh|mm+|hmm+)(\s+|$)){2,}", low):
        return True
    return False


def is_armed():
    return os.path.exists(ARM_FLAG)


def autosend_active(configured_sec):
    """True if dictation should auto-press Enter after a quiet pause.
    The config value is the default; the flag file is the voice/dashboard
    override for turning it off without editing JSON."""
    return configured_sec > 0 and not os.path.exists(AUTOSEND_OFF_FLAG)


def type_text(text):
    """Send text to whatever window has focus.

    Uses clipboard + Ctrl+V (reliable across Win32/UWP/Electron). The old
    keybd_event KEYEVENTF_UNICODE path often reported success while nothing
    appeared — that API does not deliver Unicode that way on modern Windows.
    """
    text = str(text or "")
    if not text:
        return False

    # Preferred: clipboard paste into the focused app

        import base64
        import subprocess
        b64 = base64.b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
        script = (
            "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; "
            f"$bytes=[Convert]::FromBase64String('{b64}'); "
            "$payload=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes); "
            "$prev=$null; try { $prev=[System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::GetText() } catch {}; "
            "[System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetText($payload); "
            "Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50; "
            "[System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait('^v'); "
            "Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; "
            "if ($null -ne $prev -and $prev -ne '') { "
            "  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; "
            "  try { [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetText($prev) } catch {} "
            "}; "
            "Write-Output TYPED_OK"
        )
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [
                "powershell.exe",
                "-NoProfile",
                "-NonInteractive",
                "-WindowStyle",
                "Hidden",
                "-ExecutionPolicy",
                "Bypass",
                "-Command",
                script,
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=15,
            creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0),
        )
        if completed.returncode == 0 and "TYPED_OK" in (completed.stdout or ""):
            return True
        log(f"clipboard type failed: {(completed.stderr or completed.stdout or '')[:200]}")
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"clipboard type exception: {e}")

    # Fallback: SendInput Unicode (correct structure, unlike keybd_event)

                ("dwExtraInfo", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulong)),
            ]

"""Native Antigravity bridge for Brianna.

Uses the same stack as the Antigravity IDE:
  language_server.exe + Google OAuth (Cloud Code) + --model=pro

This is NOT the free Gemini Developer API key path. It talks to the
already-authenticated Antigravity language server so Google AI Pro ($20)
subscription quota applies.

OpenAI-compatible surface on 127.0.0.1:8091 (replaces antigravity_openai_server
when native mode is enabled).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import uuid
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CONFIG_PATH = BASE / "brianna-gateway.json"
PID_PATH = BASE / "antigravity-bridge.pid"
STATE_PATH = BASE / "antigravity-native-state.json"
LOG_DIR = BASE / "logs"
LS_OUT = LOG_DIR / "antigravity-ls-native.log"
LS_ERR = LOG_DIR / "antigravity-ls-native.error.log"

DEFAULT_LS_EXE = (
    Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", ""))
    / "Programs"
    / "antigravity"
    / "resources"
    / "bin"
    / "language_server.exe"
)
DEFAULT_PROJECTS = (
    Path(os.environ.get("USERPROFILE", r"~"))
    / ".gemini"
    / "config"
    / "projects"
)
DEFAULT_BRAIN = (
    Path(os.environ.get("USERPROFILE", r"~"))
    / ".gemini"
    / "antigravity"
    / "brain"
)


def load_config() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return json.loads(CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))


CONFIG = load_config()
ANTIGRAVITY = CONFIG.get("antigravity") or {}
HOST = str(ANTIGRAVITY.get("host") or "127.0.0.1")
PORT = int(ANTIGRAVITY.get("port") or 8091)
NATIVE = ANTIGRAVITY.get("native") or {}
MODEL_ALIAS = str(NATIVE.get("model") or ANTIGRAVITY.get("model") or "pro").lower()
# agentapi only accepts flash_lite|flash|pro
if MODEL_ALIAS not in {"flash_lite", "flash", "pro"}:
    if "pro" in MODEL_ALIAS:
        MODEL_ALIAS = "pro"
    elif "lite" in MODEL_ALIAS:
        MODEL_ALIAS = "flash_lite"
    else:
        MODEL_ALIAS = "pro"

LS_EXE = Path(NATIVE.get("language_server") or DEFAULT_LS_EXE)
PROJECT_ID = str(NATIVE.get("project_id") or "").strip()
POLL_SECONDS = float(NATIVE.get("poll_seconds") or 0.6)
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = float(NATIVE.get("timeout_seconds") or 180)


def resolve_project_id() -> str:
    if PROJECT_ID:
        return PROJECT_ID
    # Prefer lastCreatedProjectId from Antigravity app storage
    app_storage = (
        Path(os.environ.get("APPDATA", ""))
        / "Antigravity"
        / "app_storage.json"
    )
    try:
        data = json.loads(app_storage.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        last = data.get("lastCreatedProjectId")
        if last:
            return str(last)
    except Exception:
        pass
    # Fall back to first project that looks real
    try:
        for p in sorted(DEFAULT_PROJECTS.glob("*.json")):
            if p.name == "outside-of-project.json":
                continue
            data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if data.get("id"):
                return str(data["id"])
    except Exception:
        pass
    return ""


def prompt_text() -> str:
    file = BASE / str(CONFIG.get("prompt_file") or "brianna-system.txt")
    try:
        return file.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").strip()
    except Exception:
        return "You are Brianna, Dell's PC assistant."


def last_user_text(messages: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    for item in reversed(messages or []):
        if item and item.get("role") == "user":
            content = item.get("content")
            if isinstance(content, str) and content.strip():
                return content.strip()
    return ""


def conversation_blob(messages: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    """Flatten recent chat into one agentapi prompt with system context."""
    system = prompt_text()
    lines = [
        "You are Brianna on Dell's Windows PC, running through native Antigravity.",
        "Act on requests (folders, media, browser, shell) using tools when needed.",
        "Keep replies short for voice. Never invent tool success.",
        "",
        "SYSTEM CONTEXT:",
        system[:8000],
        "",
        "CONVERSATION:",
    ]
    for item in (messages or [])[-16:]:
        role = str(item.get("role") or "")
        content = item.get("content")
        if role not in {"user", "assistant"} or not isinstance(content, str):
            continue
        if not content.strip():
            continue
        lines.append(f"{role.upper()}: {content.strip()[:8000]}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Reply only as Brianna to the latest USER message.")
    return "\n".join(lines)


class NativeLanguageServer:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.proc: subprocess.Popen[bytes] | None = None
        self.http_port: int | None = None
        self.csrf: str | None = None
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def save_state(self) -> None:
        STATE_PATH.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "pid": self.proc.pid if self.proc else None,
                    "http_port": self.http_port,
                    "csrf": self.csrf,
                    "project_id": resolve_project_id(),
                    "model": MODEL_ALIAS,
                    "updatedAt": time.time(),
                },
                indent=2,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

    def _port_alive(self) -> bool:
        if not self.http_port or not self.proc or self.proc.poll() is not None:
            return False
        try:
            import socket

            with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(self.http_port)), timeout=0.4):
                return True
        except OSError:
            return False

    def ensure(self) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            if (
                self.proc
                and self.proc.poll() is None
                and self.http_port
                and self.csrf
                and self._port_alive()
            ):
                return
            # Process may be zombie or port recycled — restart cleanly.
            if self.proc and self.proc.poll() is None:
                try:
                    self.proc.terminate()
                    try:
                        self.proc.wait(timeout=3)
                    except Exception:
                        self.proc.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self._start()

    def _start(self) -> None:
        if not LS_EXE.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError(f"language_server.exe not found at {LS_EXE}")

        LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.csrf = str(uuid.uuid4())
        # Close previous
        if self.proc and self.proc.poll() is None:
            try:
                self.proc.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass

        args = [
            str(LS_EXE),
            "--standalone",
            "--override_ide_name",
            "antigravity",
            "--subclient_type",
            "hub",
            "--override_ide_version",
            "2.5.0",
            "--override_user_agent_name",
            "antigravity",
            "--https_server_port",
            "0",
            "--csrf_token",
            self.csrf,
            "--app_data_dir",
            "antigravity",
            "--api_server_url",
            "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com",
            "--cloud_code_endpoint",
            "https://daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com",
            "--enable_sidecars",
            "--disable_telemetry=true",
        ]
        # Fresh logs per launch so we never pick a stale "listening on port" line.
        for path in (LS_OUT, LS_ERR):
            try:
                path.write_bytes(b"")
            except Exception:
                pass
        out = open(LS_OUT, "ab", buffering=0)
        err = open(LS_ERR, "ab", buffering=0)
        self.proc = subprocess.Pope

"""
title: Windows Desktop Automation Tool
author: Antigravity
author_url: https://github.com/
funding_url: https://github.com/

description: A tool to allow the LLM to open the web browser and interact with the Windows desktop natively.
"""
import subprocess
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Tools:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        pass

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()
        pass

    def open_web_browser(self, url: str = "https://www.google.com") -> str:
        """
        Use this tool to open a web browser on the user's computer.
        :param url: The URL to open in the browser. Defaults to google.com.
        """
        try:
            # Use PowerShell Start-Process to break out of any hidden window state
            subprocess.Popen(["powershell", "-WindowStyle", "Hidden", "-Command", f"Start-Process '{url}'"])
            return f"Successfully opened web browser to {url} on the user's screen."
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Error opening browser: {str(e)}"

import requests
import json
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import urllib.parse

class Tools:
    def __init__(self):
        pass
        
    def search_web(self, query: str) -> str:
        """
        Searches the web using DuckDuckGo to find information, news, and facts.
        :param query: The search query.
        """
        try:
            headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"}
            url = "https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=" + urllib.parse.quote(query)
            response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
            soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")
            results = []
            for a in soup.find_all("a", class_="result__snippet"):
                results.append(a.text)
            return json.dumps(results[:5])
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Search failed: {e}"
        
    def scrape_webpage(self, url: str) -> str:
        """
        Scrapes and cleans up text content from a given URL (extracts text from HTML).
        :param url: The webpage URL to scrape.
        """
        try:
            headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"}
            response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
            soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")
            for script in soup(["script", "style", "nav", "footer", "header"]):
                script.extract()
            text = soup.get_text(separator="\\n")
            lines = (line.strip() for line in text.splitlines())
            chunks = (phrase.strip() for line in lines for phrase in line.split("  "))
            text = "\\n".join(chunk for chunk in chunks if chunk)
            return text[:15000] # Return up to 15k chars
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Scraping failed: {e}"
'''

scripts.content:
import asyncio
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI, BackgroundTasks, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI(title="Kokoro OpenAI TTS API")

class SpeechRequest(BaseModel):
    model: str = "tts-1"
    input: str
    voice: str = "af_sarah"
    response_format: str = "wav"
    speed: float = 1.0

# Paths
KOKORO_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.absolute()
VOICE_STATION = KOKORO_DIR.parent
SYSTEM_CORE = VOICE_STATION.parent
ROOT = SYSTEM_CORE.parent
CONFIG_PATH = SYSTEM_CORE / "Nexus Automation Station" / "config" / "kokoro_voice.json"

def load_config():
    default = {
        "enabled": True,
        "python": str(KOKORO_DIR / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"),
        "cli": str(KOKORO_DIR / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "kokoro-tts.exe"),
        "model": str(KOKORO_DIR / "models" / "kokoro-v1.0.onnx"),
        "voices": str(KOKORO_DIR / "models" / "voices-v1.0.bin"),
        "voice": "af_sarah",
        "lang": "en-us",
        "speed": 0.92,
    }
    try:
        if CONFIG_PATH.exists():
            with open(CONFIG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
                loaded = json.load(f)
            # Only update non-path settings to avoid stale paths from JSON
            for k in ["enabled", "voice", "lang", "speed"]:
                if k in loaded:
                    default[k] = loaded[k]
    except Exception:
        pass
    return default

def cleanup_files(*paths):
    for path in paths:
        try:
            if os.path.exists(path):
                os.remove(path)
        except Exception:
            pass

@app.post("/v1/audio/speech")
async def create_speech(request: SpeechRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    config = load_config()
    
    cli = config.get("cli")
    python = config.get("python")
    model = config.get("model")
    voices_file = config.get("voices")
    
    if not os.path.exists(cli) or not os.path.exists(model) or not os.path.exists(voices_file):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Kokoro CLI or models not found.")
        
    text = request.input.strip()
    if not text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Input text cannot be empty.")
        
    fd_text, text_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="kokoro_api_", suffix=".txt")
    fd_wav, wav_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="kokoro_api_", suffix=".wav")
    os.close(fd_text)
    os.close(fd_wav)
    
    with open(text_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
        
    # Map requested voice to a valid kokoro voice if possible, or fallback to default
    voice = request.voice if request.voice.startswith(("af_", "am_", "bf_", "bm_")) else config.get("voice", "af_sarah")
    speed = request.speed if request.speed else config.get("speed", 0.92)
    
    cmd = []
    if os.path.exists(python):
        cmd.extend([python, cli])
    else:
        cmd.append(cli)
        
    cmd.extend([
        text_path,
        wav_path,
        "--model", model,
        "--voices", voices_file,
        "--speed", str(speed),
        "--lang", str(config.get("lang", "en-us")),
        "--voice", voice,
    ])
    
    try:
        # Run process asynchronously
        process = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
            *cmd,
            stdout=asyncio.subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=asyncio.subprocess.DEVNULL,
            creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
        )
        await asyncio.wait_for(process.communicate(), timeout=120.0)
        
        if process.returncode != 0:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Kokoro CLI failed to generate audio.")
            
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        process.kill()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=504, detail="Audio generation timed out.")
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Audio generation error: {str(e)}")
        
    background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_files, text_path, wav_path)
    return FileResponse(wav_path, media_type="audio/wav")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=8888)

scripts.content:
# ADB Always-On Guardian
# Keeps phones connected over ADB without babysitting.
#
# Does:
# - Starts adb server if dead
# - Reconnects every device in devices.json (IP:5555)
# - When ANY USB/wireless device is online, learns its Wi‑Fi IP and enables tcpip 5555
# - Remembers last-known-good serials
# - Escalates to adb kill-server/start-server after repeated failures
# - Tiny always-on-top badge (click = show log, right-click = menu)
# - Single instance
#
# Run hidden:  pythonw ADB_AlwaysOn_Guardian.pyw --hidden
# Install startup via: INSTALL_ADB_ALWAYS_ON.bat

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import datetime as dt
import ipaddress
import json
import os
import queue
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path

APP_NAME = "ADB Always-On Guardian"
MUTEX_NAME = "Global\\DK_ADB_ALWAYS_ON_GUARDIAN_V1"
CREATE_NO_WINDOW = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)

DESKTOP = Path.home() / "Desktop"
ROOT = DESKTOP / "Automation Creation Station"
NEXUS = ROOT / "_System_Core" / "Nexus Automation Station"
# Also support older layout without _System_Core
if not NEXUS.exists():
    NEXUS = ROOT / "Nexus Automation Station"
CONFIG = NEXUS / "config"
LOGS = NEXUS / "logs"
DEVICES_JSON = CONFIG / "devices.json"
STATE_JSON = CONFIG / "adb_always_on_state.json"
LOG_FILE = LOGS / "adb_always_on_guardian.log"

CHECK_SECONDS = 8
ESCALATE_AFTER = 3
TCPIP_PORT = 5555

BG = "#07110f"
PANEL = "#0d1b18"
TEXT = "#eafff8"
MUTED = "#8ec6b8"
GREEN = "#00ff9c"
YELLOW = "#ffd166"
RED = "#ff4d6d"
BLUE = "#4dabf7"


def stamp() -> str:
    return dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def ensure_dirs() -> None:
    CONFIG.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def file_log(msg: str) -> None:
    try:
        ensure_dirs()
        with open(LOG_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"[{stamp()}] {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def find_adb() -> str:
    candidates = [
        os.environ.get("ADB_PATH", ""),
        r"C:\adb\adb.exe",
        r"C:\platform-tools\adb.exe",
        str(Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")) / "Android" / "Sdk" / "platform-tools" / "adb.exe"),
        str(Path(os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME", "")) / "platform-tools" / "adb.exe"),
        "adb",
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if not c:
            continue
        if c == "adb":
            return c
        if Path(c).is_file():
            return c
    return "adb"


def already_running() -> bool:
    """Return True if another guardian instance owns the mutex."""
    try:
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        handle = kernel32.CreateMutexW(None, False, MUTEX_NAME)
        last = kernel32.GetLastError()
        # ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS = 183
        if last == 183:
            return True
        # Keep handle alive for process lifetime
        GuardianApp._mutex_handle = handle  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        return False
    except Exception:
        return False


def valid_ip(value: str) -> bool:
    try:
        ipaddress.ip_address(str(value).strip())
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def load_json(path: Path, default):
    try:
        if path.exists():
            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
                return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        file_log(f"load {path.name} failed: {e}")
    return default


def save_json(path: Path, data) -> None:
    ensure_dirs()
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)


def default_devices():
    return {
        "version": 3,
        "devices": {
            "Jack-s-A16": {
                "type": "android",
                "ip": "192.168.1.169",
                "port": 5555,
                "adb_serial": "192.168.1.169:5555",
                "role": "Android automation phone",
                "enabled": True,
                "adb_enabled": True,
            },
            "Hub": {
                "type": "android",
                "ip": "192.168.1.162",
                "port": 5555,
                "adb_serial": "192.168.1.162:5555",
                "role": "Android automation hub phone",
                "enabled": True,
                "adb_enabled": True,
            },
        },
    }


def normalize_device(info: dict) -> dict:
    info = dict(info or {})
    info.setdefault("type", "android")
    info.setdefault("ip", "")
    info.setdefault("port", TCPIP_PORT)
    info.setdefault("enabled", True)
    info.setdefault("adb_enabled", True)
    try:
        info["port"] = int(info.get("port", TCPIP_PORT))
    except Exception:
        info["port"] = TCPIP_PORT
    ip = str(info.get("ip", "")).strip()
    if ip:
        info["adb_serial"] = f"{ip}:{info['port']}"
    else:
        info["adb_serial"] = str(info.get("adb_serial", "")).strip()
    return info


def load_devices() -> dict:
    ensure_dirs()
    defaults = default_devices()
    data = load_json(DEVICES_JSON, defaults)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        data = defaults
    if "devices" not in data or not isinstance(data["devices"], dict):
        data["devices"] = {}
    for name, info in defaults["devices"].items():
        if name not in data["devices"]:
            data["devices"][name] = info
    for name in list(data["devices"].keys()):
        data["devices"][name] = normalize_device(data["devices"][name])
        # Force adb on for android types unless user set adb_enabled false
        d = data["devices"][name]
        if d.get("adb_enabled") is None:
            d["adb_enabled"] = True
    save_json(DEVICES_JSON, data)
    return data


class GuardianApp:
    _mutex_handle = None

    def __init__(self, start_hidden: bool = True):
        ensure_dirs()
        self.adb_path = find_adb()
        self.running = True
        self.start_hidden = start_hidden
        self.log_q: queue.Queue[str] = queue.Queue()
        self.fail_streak = 0
        self.state = load_json(STATE_JSON, {"last_good": {}, "learned_ips": {}})
        self.devices_data = load_devices()

        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title(APP_NAME)
        self.root.configure(bg=BG)
        self.root.geometry("720x420+80+80")
        self.root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.hide)

        self._build_ui()
        self._build_badge()

        self.log(f"{APP_NAME} started. adb={self.adb_path}")
        self.log(f"devices.json = {DEVICES_JSON}")
        threading.Thread(target=self.loop, daemon=True).start()
        self.root.after(150, self._drain)
        self.root.after(300, self.force_connect_all)

        if start_hidden:
            self.root.after(400, self.hide)

    def run(self):
        self.root.mainloop()

    # --- UI ---
    def _build_ui(self):
        top = tk.Frame(self.root, bg=BG)
        top.pack(fill="x", padx=12, pady=10)
        tk.Label(top, text="ADB ALWAYS-ON", bg=BG, fg=GREEN, font=("Consolas", 16, "bold")).pack(side="left")
        self.status = tk.Label(top, text="starting…", bg=BG, fg=YELLOW, font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"))
        self.status.pack(side="right")

        row = tk.Frame(self.root, bg=PANEL)
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=12, pady=4)
        for text, cmd in [
            ("Connect All Now", self.force_connect_all),
            ("Learn USB → WiFi", self.learn_from_online),
            ("Restart ADB", self.restart_adb),
            ("Hide", self.hide),
            ("Exit", self.exit_app),
        ]:
            tk.Button(
                row, text=text, command=cmd, bg="#12352d", fg=TEXT,
                activebackground=GREEN, activeforeground="#00110a",
                relief="flat", font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"), padx=8, pady=5, cursor="hand2",
            ).pack(side="left", padx=4, pady=6)

# ADB_Keeper_COMBINED_v2.pyw

def ensure_dirs():

def file_log(msg):
    try:
        ensure_dirs()

            f.write(f"[{stamp()}] {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def default_devices():
    return {

                "role": "Android automation phone",
                "enabled": True,
                "adb_enabled": True
            },
            "Hub": {
                "type": "android",
                "ip": "192.168.1.152",
                "port": 5555,
                "adb_serial": "192.168.1.152:5555",
                "role": "Android automation hub phone",
                "enabled": True,
                "adb_enabled": True
            }
        }
    }


def normalize_device(info):
    info = dict(info or {})
    info.setdefault("type", "android")
    info.setdefault("ip", "")
    info.setdefault("port", 5555)
    info.setdefault("role", "")
    info.setdefault("enabled", True)
    info.setdefault("adb_enabled", True)

    try:
        info["port"] = int(info.get("port", 5555))
    except Exception:
        info["port"] = 5555

    ip = str(info.get("ip", "")).strip()
    port = info.get("port", 5555)

    if ip:
        info["adb_serial"] = f"{ip}:{port}"
    else:
        info["adb_serial"] = str(info.get("adb_serial", "")).strip()

    return info


def save_devices(data):
    ensure_dirs()
    data["version"] = 2
    data["updated"] = dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
    with open(DEVICES_JSON, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)


def load_devices():
    ensure_dirs()
    defaults = default_devices()

    if not os.path.exists(DEVICES_JSON):
        save_devices(defaults)
        return defaults

    try:
        with open(DEVICES_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
            data = json.load(f)

        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            data = defaults

        if "devices" not in data or not isinstance(data["devices"], dict):
            data["devices"] = {}

        # Add missing default devices only. Do not overwrite user's existing IPs.
        for name, info in defaults["devices"].items():
            if name not in data["devices"]:
                data["devices"][name] = info

        for name in list(data["devices"].keys()):
            data["devices"][name] = normalize_device(data["devices"][name])

        save_devices(data)
        return data
    except Exception as e:
        file_log(f"devices.json load failed: {e}")
        return defaults


def find_adb():
    candidates = [
        os.path.join(os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME", ""), "platform-tools", "adb.exe"),
        os.path.join(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", ""), "Android", "Sdk", "platform-tools", "adb.exe"),
        r"C:\platform-tools\adb.exe",
        r"C:\adb\adb.exe",
        "adb",
    ]
    for path in candidates:
        if path == "adb":
            return path
        if path and os.path.exists(path):
            return path
    return "adb"


def should_adb_connect(info):
    if not info.get("enabled", True):
        return False

    if info.get("adb_enabled") is False:
        return False

    if info.get("adb_enabled") is True:
        return True

    dtype = str(info.get("type", "")).lower()
    return dtype in ("android", "vr_android", "quest_android")


def valid_ip(value):
    try:
        ipaddress.ip_address(str(value).strip())
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

"""
ADB Automation Studio - click-coordinate macro editor v13
Built from the uploaded NEW_ADB_SCRIPT(1).py idea, but upgraded so UI clicks become
editable macro lines instead of only raw sendevent packets.

What it does:
- Finds ADB devices.
- Records Android UI clicks as editable coordinates.
- Adds a standalone touch-source finder/debugger when UI taps are not being detected.
- Adds Samsung composite touch recording for devices that split down/up and X/Y across event nodes.
- Uses a normal movable Windows title bar plus a MOVE WINDOW rescue button/hotkey.
- Adds log filter checkboxes for UI, raw touch, app logcat, system apps, ADB, debug.
- Detects taps, long-presses, and swipes from getevent.
- v9 defaults to tap-only recording and adds swipe-to-tap repair tools.
- v10 records real wait times between gestures and uses 1000ms fixed waits when actual timing is off.
- v11 adds clean/new app launch with exclude-from-recents flags and OCR click actions.
- v12 adds one-click runner mode: pass a saved JSON path and --run, or export a runnable BAT.
- v13 adds ACS bridge integration:
  - ADB OCR can fire ACS trigger names on port 8765.
  - ADB macros can include Trigger ACS / PC Macro lines.
  - ACS can call back into ADB Studio through the local receiver on port 8766.
  - ACS-callable marker lines let a PC macro run a named Android macro section.
- Keeps raw kernel-event recording as a fallback.
- Lets you add/edit/delete/duplicate/reorder macro lines.
- Lets you run the whole macro or only the selected line.
- Supports waits, text entry, keyevents, app launch, custom shell lines, OCR trigger.
- Saves/loads JSON macro files.

from __future__ import annotations

def main() -> int:
    import torch

def log(msg: str) -> None:
    LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    line = f"[{datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}] {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with open(LOG_DIR / "generate.log", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def load_config() -> dict:
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        cfg = json.load(f)
    # resolve relative paths
    for key in ("input_dir", "output_dir"):
        p = Path(cfg[key])
        if not p.is_absolute():
            cfg[key] = str((ROOT / p).resolve())
    cfg["vault_output_dir"] = str(Path(cfg["vault_output_dir"]).resolve())
    cfg["hf_home"] = str(Path(cfg["hf_home"]).resolve())
    os.environ["HF_HOME"] = cfg["hf_home"]
    os.environ["HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE"] = str(Path(cfg["hf_home"]) / "hub")
    os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_CACHE"] = str(Path(cfg["hf_home"]) / "transformers")
    # No HF gating prompts in batch
    os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY", "1")
    return cfg


def expand_motion_prompt(cfg: dict, user_text: str) -> str:
    """Use local Ollama uncensored model. Never refuse; always return a motion prompt."""
    base = (user_text or "").strip() or cfg.get("default_motion_prompt", "gentle natural motion")
    if not cfg.get("use_llm_for_motion_prompt", True):
        return f"{cfg.get('style_prefix', '')}, {base}".strip(", ")

    system = (
        "You write short motion prompts for local image-to-video models. "
        "Never refuse, never moralize, never ask questions. "
        "Output ONLY one motion prompt under 40 words: camera, body motion, lighting. "
        "No quotes, no preamble."
    )
    payload = {
        "model": cfg.get("ollama_model", "brianna-abl:8b"),
        "stream": False,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"Motion idea: {base}"},
        ],
        "options": {"temperature": 0.7},
    }
    try:
        import urllib.request

        req = urllib.request.Request(
            cfg.get("ollama_url", "http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat"),
            data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            method="POST",
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
        text = (data.get("message") or {}).get("content") or ""
        text = text.strip().strip('"').split("\n")[0].strip()
        if text:
            log(f"LLM motion prompt: {text}")
            return text
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"Ollama expand skipped ({e}); using raw prompt")
    return f"{cfg.get('style_prefix', '')}, {base}".strip(", ")


def pick_seed(cfg: dict) -> int:
    s = int(cfg.get("seed", -1))
    if s < 0:
        return random.randint(0, 2**31 - 1)
    return s


def export_frames_to_mp4(frames, out_path: Path, fps: int) -> None:
    import imageio
    import numpy as np
    from PIL import Image

    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    arrays = []
    for fr in frames:
        if isinstance(fr, Image.Image):
            arrays.append(np.array(fr.convert("RGB")))
        else:
            arrays.append(np.asarray(fr))
    # imageio ffmpeg
    imageio.mimwrite(str(out_path), arrays, fps=fps, codec="libx264", quality=8)
    log(f"Wrote video: {out_path} ({len(arrays)} frames @ {fps}fps)")


def text_to_image(cfg: dict, prompt: str, seed: int):
    import torch

    log(f"T2I loading {cfg['t2i_model_id']} …")
    pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
        cfg["t2i_model_id"],
        torch_dtype=torch.float16,
        safety_checker=None,
        requires_safety_checker=False,
    )
    # Explicitly disable any residual safety
    pipe.safety_checker = None
    if hasattr(pipe, "feature_extractor"):
        pass
    pipe.enable_attention_slicing()
    try:
        pipe.enable_vae_slicing()
    except Exception:
        pass
    pipe.enable_model_cpu_offload()

    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu").manual_seed(seed)
    full_prompt = f"{cfg.get('style_prefix', '')}, {prompt}".strip(", ")
    log(f"T2I prompt: {full_prompt}")
    result = pipe(
        prompt=full_prompt,
        negative_prompt=cfg.get("negative_prompt_t2i", ""),
        width=int(cfg.get("t2i_width", 512)),
        height=int(cfg.get("t2i_height", 512)),
        num_inference_steps=int(cfg.get("t2i_steps", 25)),

    )
    image = result.images[0]

    if torch.cuda.is_available():

    return image


def image_to_video(cfg: dict, image, seed: int):
    import torch
    from diffusers import StableVideoDiffusionPipeline
    from diffusers.utils import load_image
    from PIL import Image

    if not isinstance(image, Image.Image):

"""Restart wall clock + work countdown without self-killing."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

CLOCK_DIR = Path(r"~\Desktop\Active Scripts\Python Scripts\Wall clock")
CFG = CLOCK_DIR / "Nexus_Wallpaper_Clock_Alarm_config.json"
PLACE = CLOCK_DIR / "wall_clock_placement.json"
WALL = CLOCK_DIR / "WALL_CLOCK.pyw"
WC_DIR = Path(
    r"~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station\_System_Core\Active Scripts\AHK Scripts\Work countdown"
)
WC_SETTINGS = WC_DIR / "DK_WORK_COUNTDOWN_VISIBLE_SAFE_SETTINGS.json"
WC_SCRIPT = WC_DIR / "Work_countdown.pyw"


def kill_targets():
    # Use tasklist + wmic filter carefully — match only .pyw script paths
    ps = r"""
$needles = @(
  'Active Scripts\Python Scripts\Wall clock\WALL_CLOCK.pyw',
  'Work countdown\Work_countdown.pyw'
)
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | ForEach-Object {
  $cl = $_.CommandLine
  if (-not $cl) { return }
  foreach ($n in $needles) {
    if ($cl -like ('*' + $n + '*')) {
      Write-Output ("KILL " + $_.ProcessId)
      Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      break
    }
  }
}
"""
    subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ps], check=False)


def main() -> int:
    cfg = json.loads(CFG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    place = json.loads(PLACE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    keep = []
    for role in ("left", "right", "center"):
        s = (place.get("slots") or {}).get(role) or {}
        cid = s.get("clock_id")
        if not cid or not s.get("enabled", True):
            continue
        if role == "center" and not s.get("present", True):
            print("skip center (monitor not present)")
            continue
        keep.append((role, cid, s))
    if not keep:
        keep = [
            (
                "left",
                "analog_main",
                {"abs_x": 1500, "abs_y": 40, "w": 300, "h": 300, "clock_type": "analog"},
            )
        ]
    new = []
    for role, cid, s in keep:
        new.append(
            {
                "id": cid,
                "type": s.get("clock_type") or "analog",
                "x": int(s.get("abs_x", 120)),
                "y": int(s.get("abs_y", 40)),
                "w": int(s.get("w", 260)),
                "h": int(s.get("h", 260)),
                "enabled": True,
                "role": role,
            }
        )
    cfg["clocks"] = new
    cfg["work_start_hour"] = 20
    cfg["work_start_minute"] = 0
    cfg["work_days"] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    cfg["work_leave_shift_label"] = "8 PM"
    cfg["locked"] = False
    CFG.write_text(json.dumps(cfg, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print("clocks:", new)

    WC_SETTINGS.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "x": 666,
                "y": 820,
                "w": 491,
                "h": 155,
                "locked": False,
                "desktop_mode": True,
                "alpha": 255,
            },
            indent=2,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print("countdown moved on-screen (was x=-7450)")

    now = datetime.now()
    work_days = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
    todays = now.replace(hour=20, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    if now.weekday() in work_days and now < todays:
        target = todays
    else:
        target = None
        for i in range(1, 8):
            probe = now + timedelta(days=i)
            if probe.weekday() in work_days:
                target = probe.replace(hour=20, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
                break
    diff = max(0, (target - now).total_seconds()) if target else 0
    hours = max(1, int(math.ceil(diff / 3600.0))) if diff else 0
    print(f"NOW={now} leave={target}")
    print(f"wall hours-only: {hours} H")
    print(
        f"countdown tiles: {int(diff//86400)}d "
        f"{int((diff%86400)//3600)}h {int((diff%3600)//60)}m"
    )

    kill_targets()
    time.sleep(1.0)

    pyw = Path(sys.executable)
    if pyw.name.lower() == "python.exe":
        cand = pyw.with_name("pythonw.exe")
        if cand.exists():
            pyw = cand
    # Prefer known good 3.12 for pygame/PyQt
    preferred = Path(r"~\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312\pythonw.exe")
    if preferred.exists():
        pyw = preferred

    subprocess.Popen([str(pyw), str(WALL)], cwd=str(CLOCK_DIR))
    time.sleep(0.8)
    if WC_SCRIPT.exists():
        subprocess.Popen([str(pyw), str(WC_SCRIPT)], cwd=str(WC_DIR))
    time.sleep(2.0)

    # list running
    ps = r"""
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | ForEach-Object {
  $cl = $_.CommandLine
  if ($cl -and ($cl -like '*Wall clock\WALL_CLOCK.pyw*' -or $cl -like '*Work_countdown.pyw*')) {
    Write-Output ("RUNNING " + $_.ProcessId + " " + $cl)
  }
}
"""
    subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ps], check=False)
    print("OK")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def make_pen(color, width=1.0):
    """Create a rounded QPen safely from a QColor, QBrush, gradient, or pen.

    PyQt6 is picky about QPen constructor overloads. Passing a gradient
    or QBrush directly into QPen can throw TypeError, so this builds an
    empty pen first and then applies the brush/color.
    """
    try:
        if isinstance(color, QPen):
            pen = QPen(color)
        else:
            pen = QPen()
            if isinstance(color, QBrush):
                pen.setBrush(color)
            elif isinstance(color, (QLinearGradient, QConicalGradient, QRadialGradient)):
                pen.setBrush(QBrush(color))
            elif isinstance(color, QColor):
                pen.setColor(color)
            else:
                pen.setColor(QColor(color))

        pen.setWidthF(float(width))
        pen.setStyle(Qt.PenStyle.SolidLine)
        pen.setCapStyle(Qt.PenCapStyle.RoundCap)
        pen.setJoinStyle(Qt.PenJoinStyle.RoundJoin)
        return pen
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"make_pen fallback used for {type(color).__name__}: {e}")
        pen = QPen(QColor(0, 212, 255))
        pen.setWidthF(float(width))
        pen.setCapStyle(Qt.PenCapStyle.RoundCap)
        pen.setJoinStyle(Qt.PenJoinStyle.RoundJoin)
        return pen

def acquire_single_instance_mutex():
    """Ensure only one WALL_CLOCK process runs (Windows named mutex)."""
    global _MUTEX_HANDLE
    if os.name != "nt":
        return True
    try:
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        handle = kernel32.CreateMutexW(None, False, MUTEX_NAME)
        if not handle:
            log("single-instance mutex: CreateMutex failed; continuing cautiously")
            return True
        last_error = kernel32.GetLastError()
        ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS = 183
        if last_error == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS:
            kernel32.CloseHandle(handle)
            log("single-instance mutex: another WALL_CLOCK instance owns the lock")
            return False
        _MUTEX_HANDLE = handle
        log(f"single-instance mutex acquired: {MUTEX_NAME}")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"single-instance mutex error: {e}")
        return True


def release_single_instance_mutex():
    global _MUTEX_HANDLE
    if os.name != "nt" or not _MUTEX_HANDLE:
        return
    try:
        ctypes.windll.kernel32.CloseHandle(_MUTEX_HANDLE)
    except Exception:
        pass
    _MUTEX_HANDLE = None
