#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import traceback
from pathlib import Path
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk


APP_TITLE = "Repair ACS Brain Chat"
TARGET = Path(
    r"~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station"
    r"\Canonical Control\LLM Station\DK_ACS_BRAIN_CHAT.pyw"
)
CREATE_NO_WINDOW = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)


def timestamp() -> str:
    return dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")


def find_pythonw() -> Path:
    candidates = [
        Path(
            r"~\AppData\Local\Programs"
            r"\Python\Python312\pythonw.exe"
        ),
        Path(sys.executable).with_name("pythonw.exe"),
        Path(sys.executable),
    ]
    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate.is_file():
            return candidate
    raise FileNotFoundError("A working Python executable was not found.")


def repair_source(source: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    patterns = [
        re.compile(
            r"(?m)^[ \t]*disabledbackground[ \t]*=[ \t]*"
            r"[^\n,]+,[ \t]*\r?\n"
        ),
        re.compile(
            r"disabledbackground[ \t]*=[ \t]*"
            r"(?:'(?:\\.|[^'])*'|\"(?:\\.|[^\"])*\"|"
            r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*)[ \t]*,[ \t]*"
        ),
        re.compile(
            r",?[ \t]*disabledbackground[ \t]*=[ \t]*"
            r"(?:'(?:\\.|[^'])*'|\"(?:\\.|[^\"])*\"|"
            r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*)[ \t]*(?=\))"
        ),
    ]

    total = 0
    repaired = source
    for pattern in patterns:
        repaired, count = pattern.subn("", repaired)
        total += count

    return repaired, total


class RepairUI:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title(APP_TITLE)
        self.root.geometry("760x480")
        self.root.minsize(690, 420)
        self.root.attributes("-topmost", True)

        self.status = tk.StringVar(value="Preparing repair...")
        self.detail = tk.StringVar(value="")
        self.progress = tk.DoubleVar(value=0)

        frame = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding=22)
        frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        ttk.Label(
            frame,
            text="ACS Brain Chat Repair",
            font=("Segoe UI", 19, "bold"),
        ).pack(anchor="w")

        ttk.Label(
            frame,
            textvariable=self.status,
            font=("Segoe UI", 11, "bold"),
        ).pack(anchor="w", pady=(18, 4))

        ttk.Label(
            frame,
            textvariable=self.detail,
            wraplength=690,
        ).pack(anchor="w", pady=(0, 12))

        ttk.Progressbar(
            frame,
            maximum=100,
            variable=self.progress,
            mode="determinate",
        ).pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 16))

        self.log = tk.Text(
            frame,
            height=14,
            wrap="word",
            state="disabled",
            font=("Consolas", 9),
        )
        self.log.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        row = ttk.Frame(frame)
        row.pack(fill="x", pady=(14, 0))

        self.launch_button = ttk.Button(
            row,
            text="Launch ACS Brain Chat",
            command=self.launch_chat,
            state="disabled",
        )
        self.launch_button.pack(side="left")

        self.close_button = ttk.Button(
            row,
            text="Close",
            command=self.root.destroy,
            state="disabled",
        )
        self.close_button.pack(side="right")

        self.finished = False
        self.root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.close_request)
        self.root.after(250, self.repair)

    def close_request(self) -> None:
        if self.finished:
            self.root.destroy()
        else:
            self.detail.set("Repair is still running.")

    def write_log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log.configure(state="normal")
        self.log.insert("end", message.rstrip() + "\n")
        self.log.see("end")
        self.log.configure(state="disabled")

    def stage(self, percent: int, status: str, detail: str = "") -> None:
        self.progress.set(percent)
        self.status.set(status)
        self.detail.set(detail)
        self.root.update_idletasks()

    def repair(self) -> None:
        backup = None
        temporary = None

        try:
            self.stage(8, "Checking ACS Brain Chat", str(TARGET))
            if not TARGET.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Chat file not found:\n{TARGET}")

            original = TARGET.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            self.write_log(f"Target: {TARGET}")

            self.stage(24, "Creating full backup")
            backup = TARGET.with_name(
                f"{TARGET.stem}.backup_before_disabledbackground_fix_"
                f"{timestamp()}{TARGET.suffix}"
            )
            shutil.copy2(TARGET, backup)
            self.write_log(f"Backup: {backup}")

            self.stage(42, "Removing invalid Tkinter option")
            repaired, replacements = repair_source(original)

            if replacements == 0:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    'Could not safely remove "disabledbackground".'
                )

            self.write_log(
                f"Removed disabledbackground option(s): {replacements}"
            )

            self.stage(62, "Syntax-checking complete chat program")
            compile(repaired, str(TARGET), "exec")
            self.write_log("Syntax check passed.")

            self.stage(78, "Saving repaired chat")
            fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
                prefix="DK_ACS_BRAIN_CHAT_repair_",
                suffix=".pyw",
                dir=str(TARGET.parent),
            )
            os.close(fd)
            temporary = Path(temp_name)
            temporary.write_text(repaired, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
            compile(
                temporary.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
                str(TARGET),
                "exec",
            )
            os.replace(temporary, TARGET)
            temporary = None

            self.stage(90, "Launching repaired chat")
            self.launch_chat()

            self.stage(
                100,
                "SUCCESS — ACS Brain Chat repaired",
                'The unsupported "disabledbackground" option was removed.',
            )
            self.finished = True
            self.launch_button.configure(state="normal")
            self.close_button.configure(state="normal")
            self.root.bell()

        except Exception as exc:
            if temporary is not None:
                try:
                    temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            self.status.set("FAILED — backup preserved")
            self.detail.set(str(exc))
            self.write_log(traceback.format_exc())
            if backup:
                self.write_log(f"Backup remains at: {backup}")
            self.finished = True
            self.close_button.configure(state="normal")
            self.root.bell()

    def launch_chat(self) -> None:
        try:
            pythonw = find_pythonw()
            subprocess.Popen(
                [str(pythonw), str(TARGET)],
                cwd=str(TARGET.parent),
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
                close_fds=True,
            )
            self.write_log(f"Launched with: {pythonw}")
        except Exception as exc:
            self.detail.set(f"Repair saved, but launch failed: {exc}")
            self.write_log(traceback.format_exc())

    def run(self) -> None:
        self.root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    RepairUI().run()

        main_h = parent.winfo_height()
        self.geometry(f"220x70+{main_x+10}+{main_y+main_h-80}")

        # Variables for dragging
        self._drag_data = {"x": 0, "y": 0}
        self._dragging = False

        # --- UI inside the panel ---
        self.clock_frame = tk.Frame(self, bg="#1e1e1e")
        self.clock_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=5, pady=5)

        # System clock label

# ===== DK FOLDER PICKER AND COMPACT TRIM PROGRESS V1 BEGIN =====
import collections as _dkftp_collections
import os as _dkftp_os
import subprocess as _dkftp_subprocess
import tempfile as _dkftp_tempfile
import threading as _dkftp_threading
import time as _dkftp_time
from pathlib import Path as _DKFTPPath

from tkinter import messagebox as _dkftp_messagebox

_DKFTP_OLD_INIT = UltimatePlayer.__init__


def _dkftp_hidden_process_options():
    options = {}

    if _dkftp_os.name == "nt":
        options["creationflags"] = getattr(
            _dkftp_subprocess,
            "CREATE_NO_WINDOW",
            0,
        )

        try:
            startup = _dkftp_subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
            startup.dwFlags |= _dkftp_subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
            startup.wShowWindow = 0
            options["startupinfo"] = startup
        except Exception:
            pass

    return options


def _dkftp_hidden_run(command, **kwargs):
    options = _dkftp_hidden_process_options()
    options.update(kwargs)
    return _dkftp_subprocess.run(command, **options)


def _dkftp_open_folder(path):
    path = _dkftp_os.path.abspath(
        _dkftp_os.path.normpath(str(path))
    )
    _dkftp_os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)

    if _dkftp_os.name == "nt":
        _dkftp_subprocess.Popen(
            ["explorer.exe", path],
            stdout=_dkftp_subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=_dkftp_subprocess.DEVNULL,
            close_fds=True,
            **_dkftp_hidden_process_options(),
        )
    else:
        _dkftp_subprocess.Popen(
            ["xdg-open", path],
            stdout=_dkftp_subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=_dkftp_subprocess.DEVNULL,
            close_fds=True,
        )


def _dkftp_select_folder(self):
    """Use a normal parented folder chooser that stays above the player."""
    current = str(
        getattr(self, "playlist_dir", "")
        or _DKFTPPath.home()
    )

    if not _dkftp_os.path.isdir(current):
        videos = _DKFTPPath.home() / "Videos"
        current = str(
            videos if videos.is_dir() else _DKFTPPath.home()
        )

    previous_topmost = False
    try:
        previous_topmost = bool(
            self.root.attributes("-topmost")
        )
    except Exception:
        previous_topmost = False

    try:
        # A parent prevents the Windows folder dialog from appearing
        # underneath a fullscreen/topmost video window.
        try:
            self.root.attributes("-topmost", False)
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.root.update_idletasks()

        folder = _dkftp_filedialog.askdirectory(
            parent=self.root,
            title="Choose Video Folder",
            initialdir=current,
            mustexist=True,
        )
    finally:
        def restore_player_window():
            try:
                self.root.attributes(
                    "-topmost",
                    previous_topmost,
                )
                self.root.lift()
                self.root.focus_force()
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            self.root.after(120, restore_player_window)
        except Exception:
            restore_player_window()

    if not folder:
        return

    self.playlist_dir = _dkftp_os.path.abspath(
        _dkftp_os.path.normpath(folder)
    )

    try:
        self.load_playlist()
        if self.playlist:

        )
    except Exception as exc:

            "Open Folder",
            str(exc),
            parent=self.root,
        )

    try:
        self.root.update_idletasks()

        x = self.root.winfo_rootx() + 18
        y = (
            self.root.winfo_rooty()
            + self.root.winfo_height()
            - height
            - 20
        )

        # Keep it visible even when a monitor has negative coordinates.
        screen_width = self.root.winfo_screenwidth()
        screen_height = self.root.winfo_screenheight()

        if x + width > screen_width:
            x = screen_width - width - 10
        if y + height > screen_height:
            y = screen_height - height - 10

            messagebox.showerror("DK Nest Capture", f"Could not send stop command:\n{exc}")

    def open_recordings(self) -> None:
        OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        os.startfile(str(OUTPUT_DIR))

    def read_status(self) -> dict:
        try:
            return json.loads(STATUS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            return {
                "state": "STARTING",
                "message": "Waiting for OBS automation status…",
                "recording": False,
            }

    def refresh_status(self) -> None:
        data = self.read_status()
        state = str(data.get("state", "UNKNOWN")).upper()
        message = str(data.get("message", ""))
        recording = bool(data.get("recording", False))

        if recording and self.started_at is None:
            self.started_at = time.monotonic()
        elif not recording:
            self.started_at = None

        if state != self.last_state:
            self.last_state = state

        color = {
            "RECORDING": RED,
            "STARTING": ORANGE,
            "STOPPING": ORANGE,
            "READY": GREEN,
            "WAITING": CYAN,
            "SAVED": GREEN,
            "OFFLINE": MUTED,
            "ERROR": RED,
        }.get(state, TEXT)

        self.state_label.configure(text=state, fg=color)
        self.message_label.configure(text=message)

        if self.started_at is not None:
            elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - self.started_at)
            hours, remainder = divmod(elapsed, 3600)
            minutes, seconds = divmod(remainder, 60)
            self.timer_label.configure(
                text=f"RECORDING TIME  {hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}"
            )
        else:
            self.timer_label.configure(
                text=f"SAVES TO  {OUTPUT_DIR}"
            )

        self.after(500, self.refresh_status)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    Controller().mainloop()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
DK ACS Live Telemetry Service

Tails the shared ACS telemetry event stream and safely posts important events
into the connected ChatGPT page through the browser DevTools connection.

It never runs raw commands. It only reports events already emitted by ACS.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import tkinter as tk

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
EVENTS_FILE = HERE / "acs_live_events.ndjson"
STATE_FILE = HERE / "acs_live_state.json"
PUBLISHER_STATE_FILE = HERE / "acs_publisher_state.json"
CONFIG_FILE = HERE / "telemetry_config.json"
LOG_FILE = HERE / "telemetry_service.log"
OFFSET_FILE = HERE / "publisher_offset.txt"

ACS_ROOT = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "Automation Creation Station"
DIRECT_BRIDGE = ACS_ROOT / "ChatGPT Direct Bridge"
PROFILE_ROOT = DIRECT_BRIDGE / "Browser Profile"

CREATE_NO_WINDOW = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
DETACHED_PROCESS = getattr(subprocess, "DETACHED_PROCESS", 0)
MUTEX_NAME = "Global\\DK_ACS_LIVE_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_V1"


def hidden_subprocess_kwargs(extra_flags: int = 0) -> dict:
    kwargs = {}
    flags = CREATE_NO_WINDOW | extra_flags
    if flags:
        kwargs["creationflags"] = flags
    startupinfo_factory = getattr(subprocess, "STARTUPINFO", None)
    if startupinfo_factory:
        startupinfo = startupinfo_factory()
        startupinfo.dwFlags |= getattr(subprocess, "STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW", 1)
        startupinfo.wShowWindow = 0
        kwargs["startupinfo"] = startupinfo
    return kwargs


DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    "enabled": True,
    "poll_seconds": 0.35,
    "browser_retry_seconds": 2.0,
    "send_job_start": True,
    "send_multi_action_progress": True,
    "send_job_success": True,
    "send_job_error": True,
    "send_manual_events": True,
    "maximum_queue": 200,
}


def now_text() -> str:
    return datetime.now().isoformat(sep=" ", timespec="milliseconds")


def log(message: str) -> None:
    try:
        HERE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with LOG_FILE.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(f"[{now_text()}] {message}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def load_json(path: Path, default):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return default


def save_json(path: Path, payload) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    temporary.replace(path)


def load_config() -> dict:
    config = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    loaded = load_json(CONFIG_FILE, {})
    if isinstance(loaded, dict):
        config.update(loaded)
    return config


def save_config(config: dict) -> None:
    save_json(CONFIG_FILE, config)


def append_event(payload: dict) -> None:
    HERE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    payload = dict(payload)
    payload.setdefault("timestamp", now_text())
    with EVENTS_FILE.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def show_osd(title: str, lines: list[str], seconds: float = 6.0) -> None:
    try:
        root = tk.Tk()
        root.overrideredirect(True)
        root.attributes("-topmost", True)
        root.configure(bg="#080b10")

        frame = tk.Frame(
            root,
            bg="#080b10",
            highlightbackground="#00e5ff",
            highlightthickness=2,
            padx=18,
            pady=14,
        )
        frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            text=title,
            bg="#080b10",
            fg="#00e5ff",
            font=("Segoe UI", 17, "bold"),
            anchor="w",
        ).pack(fill="x")

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            text="\n".join(lines),
            bg="#080b10",
            fg="white",
            font=("Segoe UI", 12),
            justify="left",
            anchor="w",
            pady=8,
        ).pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        root.update_idletasks()
        width = min(max(root.winfo_reqwidth(), 520), 880)
        height = min(max(root.winfo_reqheight(), 160), 440)
        root.geometry(
            f"{width}x{height}+35+"
            f"{max(90, root.winfo_screenheight() - height - 90)}"
        )
        root.after(int(seconds * 1000), root.destroy)
        root.mainloop()
    except Exception:
        pass


def run_powershell(command: str, timeout: int = 12) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    return subprocess.run(
        [
            "powershell.exe",
            "-NoLogo",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-NonInteractive",
            "-WindowStyle",
            "Hidden",
            "-ExecutionPolicy",
            "Bypass",
            "-Command",
            command,
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        errors="replace",
        timeout=timeout,
        check=False,
        **hidden_subprocess_kwargs(),
    )


def candidate_ports() -> list[int]:
    ports: list[int] = []

    files = [
        PROFILE_ROOT / "DevToolsActivePort",
        DIRECT_BRIDGE / "DevToolsActivePort",
    ]
    try:
        files.extend(DIRECT_BRIDGE.rglob("DevToolsActivePort"))
    except Exception:
        pass

    for path in files:
        try:
            port = int(
                path.read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8",
                    errors="replace",
                ).splitlines()[0].strip()
            )
            if 1 <= port <= 65535:
                ports.append(port)
        except Exception:
            pass

    result = run_powershell(
        r"""
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
Where-Object {$_.Name -match '^(chrome|msedge)\.exe$'} |
ForEach-Object {
    if ($_.CommandLine -match '--remote-debugging-port(?:=|\s+)(\d+)') {
        $Matches[1]
    }
}
"""
    )
    for match in re.findall(r"\b(\d{2,5})\b", result.stdout or ""):
        try:
            ports.append(int(match))
        except ValueError:
            pass

    ports.extend([9222, 9223, 9224, 9225, 9229, 9230])

    unique: list[int] = []
    for port in ports:
        if 1 <= port <= 65535 and port not in unique:
            unique.append(port)
    return unique


def http_json(url: str, timeout: float = 1.2):
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        headers={"User-Agent": "DK-ACS-Telemetry/1.0"},
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
        return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))


def find_chatgpt_target() -> dict | None:
    for port in candidate_ports():
        try:
            entries = http_json(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json/list")
        except Exception:
            continue

        if not isinstance(entries, list):
            continue

        for entry in entries:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                continue
            url = str(entry.get("url", "")).lower()
            if (
                str(entry.get("type", "")) == "page"
                and entry.get("webSocketDebuggerUrl")
                and ("chatgpt.com" in url or "chat.openai.com" in url)
            ):
                item = dict(entry)
                item["_port"] = port
                return item
    return None


class WebSocketClient:

        self.url = url
        self.timeout = timeout

        self.buffer = b""

    def connect(self) -> None:

    payload = {

        "created": now_iso(),
        "source": source,
        "request": request,
    }
    path = INBOX / f"{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}_{task_id}.json"

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CONFIG_PATH = ROOT / "ACS_CANONICAL_CONFIG.json"
STATUS_PATH = ROOT / "ACS_HEALTH_STATUS.json"
LOG_PATH = ROOT / "ACS_HEALTH_MONITOR.log"
MUTEX_NAME = r"Global\DK_ACS_HEALTH_MONITOR_V1"
CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60
FAILURE_ALERT_COOLDOWN_MINUTES = 15


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def log(message: str) -> None:
    line = f"{now_iso()}  {message}\n"
    try:
        with LOG_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(line)
    except Exception:
        pass


def acquire_single_instance():
    kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
    handle = kernel32.CreateMutexW(None, False, MUTEX_NAME)
    if not handle:
        return None, False
    return handle, kernel32.GetLastError() != 183


def port_is_listening(port: int | None) -> bool:
    if not port:
        return False
    try:
        with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(port)), timeout=0.8):
            return True
    except OSError:
        return False


def run_powershell(script_text: str, timeout: int = 10) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    flags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [
                "powershell.exe",
                "-NoProfile",
                "-NonInteractive",
                "-ExecutionPolicy",
                "Bypass",
                "-Command",
                script_text,
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=timeout,
            creationflags=flags,
        )
        return result.returncode == 0, (result.stdout or result.stderr).strip()
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"


def process_running_for_path(path: str) -> bool:
    escaped = path.replace("'", "''")
    script = (
        "$p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | "
        f"Where-Object {{ ([string]$_.CommandLine) -like '*{escaped}*' }} | "
        "Select-Object -First 1 ProcessId; "
        "if ($p) { 'YES' }"
    )
    ok, output = run_powershell(script)
    return ok and "YES" in output


def python_executable(windowless: bool) -> str:
    current = Path(sys.executable)
    if windowless:
        candidate = current.with_name("pythonw.exe")
        if candidate.exists():
            return str(candidate)
    return str(current)


def build_command(component: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    path = Path(component["path"])
    start_type = component.get("start_type", "")
    arguments = list(component.get("arguments") or [])

    if start_type == "pythonw":
        return [python_executable(True), str(path), *arguments]
    if start_type == "python":
        return [python_executable(False), str(path), *arguments]
    if start_type == "powershell":
        return [
            "powershell.exe",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-ExecutionPolicy",
            "Bypass",
            "-File",
            str(path),
            *arguments,
        ]
    if start_type == "vbs":
        return ["wscript.exe", str(path), *arguments]
    if start_type in ("bat", "cmd"):
        return ["cmd.exe", "/c", str(path), *arguments]
    return [str(path), *arguments]


def component_is_healthy(component: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    path = Path(component["path"])
    if not path.exists():
        return False, "file_missing"

    expected_port = component.get("expected_port")
    if expected_port:
        if port_is_listening(int(expected_port)):
            return True, f"port_{expected_port}_listening"
        return False, f"port_{expected_port}_not_listening"

    if process_running_for_path(str(path)):
        return True, "process_running"

    return False, "process_not_found"


def start_component(component: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    path = Path(component["path"])
    if not path.exists():
        return False, "file_missing"

    command = build_command(component)
    cwd = component.get("working_directory") or str(path.parent)
    flags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)

    try:
        subprocess.Popen(
            command,
            cwd=cwd,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            creationflags=flags,
            close_fds=True,
        )
        return True, "start_command_sent"
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"


def show_failure_osd(failures: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    try:
        import tkinter as tk

        root = tk.Tk()
        root.title("ACS Needs Attention")
        root.configure(bg="#210b0b")
        root.attributes("-topmost", True)
        root.overrideredirect(True)

        width = 620
        height = min(330, 120 + len(failures) * 52)
        screen_width = root.winfo_screenwidth()
        screen_height = root.winfo_screenheight()
        x = max(20, screen_width - width - 30)
        y = max(20, screen_height - height - 60)
        root.geometry(f"{width}x{height}+{x}+{y}")

        tk.Label(
            root,
            text="ACS COULD NOT RECOVER A COMPONENT",
            font=("Segoe UI", 15, "bold"),
            fg="#ffffff",
            bg="#210b0b",
        ).pack(pady=(18, 8))

        text = "\n".join(
            f"{item['name']}: {item['final_reason']}"
            for item in failures[:4]
        )
        tk.Label(
            root,
            text=text,
            justify="left",
            anchor="w",
            font=("Segoe UI", 11),
            fg="#ffe3e3",
            bg="#210b0b",
            wraplength=570,
        ).pack(fill="x", padx=24)

        tk.Label(
            root,
            text=f"Details: {STATUS_PATH}",
            font=("Segoe UI", 9),
            fg="#d9bcbc",
            bg="#210b0b",
        ).pack(pady=(14, 0))

        root.after(15000, root.destroy)
        root.mainloop()
    except Exception:
        pass


def load_config() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return json.loads(CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def run_health_cycle(
    alert_history: dict[str, datetime],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    started = now_iso()
    config = load_config()
    results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    unresolved: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    components = sorted(
        config.get("components", []),
        key=lambda item: int(item.get("priority", 999)),
    )

    for component in components:
        if not component.get("enabled", True):
            continue
        if component.get("role") == "health_monitor":
            continue

        name = component.get("name", "Unnamed component")
        healthy, reason = component_is_healthy(component)

        row: dict[str, Any] = {
            "name": name,
            "role": component.get("role"),
            "path": component.get("path"),
            "initial_healthy": healthy,
            "initial_reason": reason,
            "restart_attempted": False,
            "restart_sent": False,
            "final_healthy": healthy,
            "final_reason": reason,
        }

        if not healthy:
            row["restart_attempted"] = True
            sent, start_reason = start_component(component)
            row["restart_sent"] = sent
            row["restart_reason"] = start_reason
            log(f"RESTART {name}: {start_reason}")

            if sent:
                wait_seconds = 12 if component.get("expected_port") else 5
                time.sleep(wait_seconds)

            final_healthy, final_reason = component_is_healthy(component)
            row["final_healthy"] = final_healthy
            row["final_reason"] = final_reason

def enforce_single_instance():
    global lock_file_handle
    lock_file_handle = open(LOCK_FILE, "w")
    try:
        msvcrt.locking(lock_file_handle.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
    except OSError:
        sys.exit(0)

def process_results():
    if not os.path.exists(RESULTS_DIR):
        return
        
    files = [f for f in os.listdir(RESULTS_DIR) if f.endswith(".json") and f.startswith("Result_")]
    if not files:
        return
        
    for f in files:
        filepath = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, f)
        try:
            with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as jf:
                data = json.load(jf)
                
            intent = data.get("intent", "Unknown Task")
            status = data.get("status", "unknown").upper()
            completed = data.get("completed_at", "Unknown Time")
            details = json.dumps(data.get("results", []), indent=2)
            
            # Format the output for the AI to read easily
            injection = f"\n\n======================================================\n"
            injection += f"LATEST AI EXECUTION RESULT: {status}\n"
            injection += f"Task: {intent}\n"
            injection += f"Time: {completed}\n"
            injection += f"Details:\n{details}\n"
            injection += f"======================================================\n"
            
            # Append to the handoff file
            with open(HANDOFF_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as hf:
                hf.write(injection)
                
            # Move to archive
            shutil.move(filepath, os.path.join(ARCHIVE_DIR, f))
            
        except Exception as e:
            pass # Fail silently, try again next loop

def main_loop():
    enforce_single_instance()
    while True:
        process_results()
        time.sleep(2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main_loop()

def acquire_mutex():

    if kernel32.GetLastError() == 183:

        raise SystemExit(0)

def safe_filename(value: str, fallback: str = "New Item") -> str:
    value = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value)
    value = INVALID_FILENAME.sub("_", value).rstrip(" .")
    return value[:180] or fallback


def strip_tail(value: str) -> str:
    value = value.strip()
    while value.endswith((".", "!", "?")):
        value = value[:-1].rstrip()
    return value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")


def unique_path(path: Path) -> Path:
    if not path.exists():
        return path
    for number in range(2, 10000):
        candidate = path.with_name(f"{path.stem} ({number}){path.suffix}")
        if not candidate.exists():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError(f"Could not choose a unique destination for {path}")


def resolve_location(value: str) -> Path:
    text = strip_tail(value)

        "desktop": DESKTOP,
        "my desktop": DESKTOP,
        "documents": DOCUMENTS,
        "my documents": DOCUMENTS,
        "downloads": DOWNLOADS,
        "my downloads": DOWNLOADS,
        "command center": COMMAND_CENTER,
        "desktop command center": COMMAND_CENTER,
    }
    if text.lower() in aliases:
        return aliases[text.lower()]
    candidate = Path(os.path.expandvars(os.path.expanduser(text)))
    return candidate if candidate.is_absolute() else DESKTOP / text


def candidate_roots() -> list[Path]:
    return [DESKTOP, DOCUMENTS, DOWNLOADS, COMMAND_CENTER, ACS_ROOT]


def resolve_existing_item(value: str) -> Path:
    text = strip_tail(value)
    text = re.sub(r"^(?:the\s+)?(?:desktop\s+)?(?:file|folder|icon|shortcut)\s+", "", text, flags=re.I).strip()
    expanded = Path(os.path.expandvars(os.path.expanduser(text)))
    if expanded.is_absolute() and expanded.exists():
        return expanded
    variants = [text]
    if not Path(text).suffix:
        variants += [text + ".lnk", text + ".url", text + ".txt"]
    for root in candidate_roots():
        if not root.exists():
            continue
        for variant in variants:
            direct = root / variant
            if direct.exists():

        try:
            lowered = text.casefold()

    for root in [COMMAND_CENTER, ACS_ROOT]:

        try:

    raise FileNotFoundError(f"I could not find: {text}")

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk


class InteractiveTaskGuard:
    # Use this only inside the same script that is sending the UI automation.
    # Windows BlockInput permits the blocking thread to send automation input.

    def __init__(
        self,
        title: str,
        message: str,
        timeout_seconds: int = 120,
    ) -> None:
        self.title = str(title)
        self.message = str(message)
        self.timeout_seconds = max(10, int(timeout_seconds))
        self._stop = threading.Event()
        self._ready = threading.Event()
        self._root = None
        self._message_var = None
        self._progress_var = None
        self._elapsed_var = None
        self._started = 0.0
        self._overlay_thread = None
        self._watchdog_thread = None
        self._user32 = ctypes.WinDLL("user32", use_last_error=True)

    def __enter__(self):
        self.start()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
        self.stop()

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self._overlay_thread and self._overlay_thread.is_alive():
            return

        self._started = time.monotonic()
        self._stop.clear()
        self._ready.clear()

        self._overlay_thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._overlay_main,
            daemon=True,
            name="DKInteractiveTaskOverlay",
        )
        self._watchdog_thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._watchdog_main,
            daemon=True,
            name="DKInteractiveTaskWatchdog",
        )

        self._overlay_thread.start()
        if not self._ready.wait(5):
            raise RuntimeError("Interactive task OSD did not open.")

        if not self._user32.BlockInput(True):
            self.stop()
            raise OSError(
                ctypes.get_last_error(),
                "Windows refused to block physical input.",
            )

        self._watchdog_thread.start()

    def update(
        self,
        message: str,
        progress_percent: int | float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if self._root is None:
            return

        def apply_update() -> None:
            if self._message_var is not None:
                self._message_var.set(str(message))
            if (
                progress_percent is not None
                and self._progress_var is not None
            ):
                self._progress_var.set(
                    max(0.0, min(100.0, float(progress_percent)))
                )

        try:
            self._root.after(0, apply_update)
        except tk.TclError:
            pass

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop.set()
        try:
            self._user32.BlockInput(False)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if self._root is not None:
            try:
                self._root.after(0, self._root.destroy)
            except tk.TclError:
                pass

        current = threading.current_thread()
        for thread in (
            self._overlay_thread,
            self._watchdog_thread,
        ):
            if thread and thread.is_alive() and thread is not current:
                thread.join(timeout=2)

    def _watchdog_main(self) -> None:
        if self._stop.wait(self.timeout_seconds):
            return

        self.update(
            "Safety timeout reached. Restoring control now.",
            100,
        )
        time.sleep(0.8)
        self.stop()

    def _overlay_main(self) -> None:
        root = tk.Tk()
        self._root = root
        root.withdraw()
        root.overrideredirect(True)
        root.attributes("-topmost", True)
        root.attributes("-alpha", 0.94)
        root.configure(bg="#070b10")

        x = self._user32.GetSystemMetrics(76)
        y = self._user32.GetSystemMetrics(77)
        width = self._user32.GetSystemMetrics(78)
        height = self._user32.GetSystemMetrics(79)
        root.geometry(f"{width}x{height}+{x}+{y}")

        frame = tk.Frame(root, bg="#070b10")
        frame.place(relx=0.5, rely=0.5, anchor="center")

        self._message_var = tk.StringVar(value=self.message)
        self._progress_var = tk.DoubleVar(value=0)
        self._elapsed_var = tk.StringVar(value="Elapsed: 00:00")

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            text="INTERACTIVE AUTOMATION MODE",
            font=("Segoe UI Semibold", 28),
            fg="#38bdf8",
            bg="#070b10",
        ).pack(pady=(0, 20))

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            text=self.title,
            font=("Segoe UI Semibold", 38),
            fg="#ffffff",
            bg="#070b10",
            wraplength=max(700, int(width * 0.72)),
            justify="center",
        ).pack(pady=(0, 20))

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            textvariable=self._message_var,
            font=("Segoe UI", 22),
            fg="#dce8ee",
            bg="#070b10",
            wraplength=max(700, int(width * 0.72)),
            justify="center",
        ).pack(pady=(0, 24))

        canvas_width = max(700, int(width * 0.55))
        bar = tk.Canvas(
            frame,
            width=canvas_width,
            height=36,
            bg="#1b2730",
            highlightthickness=0,
        )
        bar.pack(pady=(0, 18))

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            textvariable=self._elapsed_var,
            font=("Consolas", 20, "bold"),
            fg="#ffffff",
            bg="#070b10",
        ).pack(pady=(0, 20))

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            text=(
                "ACS is temporarily controlling Windows. "
                "Physical keyboard and mouse input are locked."
            ),
            font=("Segoe UI", 18),
            fg="#fbbf24",
            bg="#070b10",
            wraplength=max(700, int(width * 0.72)),
            justify="center",
        ).pack(pady=(0, 10))

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            text=(
                "Ctrl+Alt+Delete is the emergency release. "
                "A safety timeout will also restore control automatically."
            ),
            font=("Segoe UI Semibold", 18),
            fg="#fca5a5",
            bg="#070b10",
            wraplength=max(700, int(width * 0.72)),
            justify="center",
        ).pack()

        def tick() -> None:
            if self._stop.is_set():
                try:
                    root.destroy()
                except tk.TclError:
                    pass
                return

            elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - self._started)
            minutes, seconds = divmod(elapsed, 60)
            self._elapsed_var.set(
                f"Elapsed: {minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}"
            )

            value = float(self._progress_var.get())
            fill_width = int(canvas_width * value / 100.0)

            bar.delete("all")
            bar.create_rectangle(
                0,
                0,
                canvas_width,
                36,
                fill="#1b2730",
                outline="",
            )
            bar.create_rectangle(
                0,
                0,
                fill_width,
                36,
                fill="#38bdf8",
                outline="",
            )
            bar.create_text(
                canvas_width // 2,
                18,
                text=f"{int(value)}%",
                fill="#ffffff",
                font=("Segoe UI Semibold", 13),
            )

            root.after(200, tick)

        root.deiconify()
        root.lift()
        self._ready.set()
        root.after(100, tick)
        root.mainloop()

        self._root = None
        self._stop.set()
        try:
            self._user32.BlockInput(False)
        except Exception:
            pass

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(
    r"~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station"
    r"\Tagged Download Auto-Runner"
)
MONITOR = ROOT / "DK_SCRIPT_ACTIVITY_MONITOR.pyw"
STATE_DIR = ROOT / "State"
RUNTIME_STATUS = STATE_DIR / "monitor_runtime_status.json"
KEEPALIVE_STATUS = STATE_DIR / "monitor_keepalive_status.json"
LOCK_PATH = STATE_DIR / "monitor_keepalive_instance.lock"
LOG = ROOT / "Logs" / "monitor_keepalive.log"
STDOUT_LOG = ROOT / "Logs" / "monitor_stdout.log"
STDERR_LOG = ROOT / "Logs" / "monitor_stderr.log"

CHECK_SECONDS = 5.0
STALE_SECONDS = 15.0
RESTART_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 12.0


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def load_json(path: Path, default):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return default


def save_json(path: Path, data) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temp.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    os.replace(temp, path)


def log(message: str) -> None:
    try:
        LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(f"{now_iso()}  {message}\n")
    except OSError:
        pass


def choose_pythonw() -> Path:
    candidates = [
        Path(sys.executable),
        Path(
            r"~\AppData\Local\Programs"
            r"\Python\Python312\pythonw.exe"
        ),
        Path(
            r"~\AppData\Local\Programs"
            r"\Python\Python314\pythonw.exe"
        ),
    ]

    for item in candidates:
        if item.name.lower() == "python.exe":
            pyw = item.with_name("pythonw.exe")
            if pyw.is_file():
                return pyw
        if item.is_file():
            return item

    raise FileNotFoundError("A working pythonw.exe could not be found.")


def powershell(script_text: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        [
            "powershell.exe",
            "-NoLogo",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-NonInteractive",
            "-ExecutionPolicy",
            "Bypass",
            "-Command",
            script_text,
        ],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=25,
        creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0),
        check=False,
    )


def monitor_processes() -> list[dict]:
    filename = MONITOR.name.replace("'", "''")
    ps = f"""
$items = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {{
    $_.Name -match '^python(w)?[.]exe$' -and
    $_.CommandLine -and
    $_.CommandLine.IndexOf(
        '{filename}',
        [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
    ) -ge 0
}} | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine

$items | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 -Compress
"""
    completed = powershell(ps)
    output = completed.stdout.strip()

    if not output:
        return []

    try:
        parsed = json.loads(output)
        return parsed if isinstance(parsed, list) else [parsed]
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return []


def stop_monitor_processes() -> list[int]:
    filename = MONITOR.name.replace("'", "''")
    ps = f"""
$ids = @()
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {{
    $_.Name -match '^python(w)?[.]exe$' -and
    $_.CommandLine -and
    $_.CommandLine.IndexOf(
        '{filename}',
        [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
    ) -ge 0
}} | ForEach-Object {{
    $ids += [int]$_.ProcessId
    Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}}
$ids | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
"""
    completed = powershell(ps)
    output = completed.stdout.strip()

    if not output:
        return []

    try:
        parsed = json.loads(output)
        return parsed if isinstance(parsed, list) else [int(parsed)]
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return []


def runtime_age() -> float | None:
    data = load_json(RUNTIME_STATUS, {})
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return None

    value = str(data.get("updated_at", "")).strip()
    if not value:
        return None

    try:
        stamp = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
        return max(
            0.0,
            (datetime.now(stamp.tzinfo) - stamp).total_seconds(),
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


def start_monitor() -> int:
    pythonw = choose_pythonw()
    LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with STDOUT_LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stdout_handle, \
            STDERR_LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stderr_handle:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(pythonw), str(MONITOR)],
            cwd=str(ROOT),
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=stdout_handle,
            stderr=stderr_handle,
            creationflags=(
                getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
                | getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0)
            ),
            close_fds=True,
        )

    return process.pid


def main() -> int:
    STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    kernel32.SetLastError(0)
    mutex = kernel32.CreateMutexW(
        None,

REQUEST_HISTORY = REQUEST_ROOT / "request_history.jsonl"
DOWNLOADS_DIR = Path(r"D:\Dell\Downloads")


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def load_json(path: Path, default):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return default


def save_json(path: Path, data) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temp.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    os.replace(temp, path)


def append_jsonl(path: Path, data: dict) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def elapsed_text(seconds) -> str:
    try:
        total = max(0, int(float(seconds)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        total = 0

    minutes, secs = divmod(total, 60)
    hours, minutes = divmod(minutes, 60)
    return (
        f"{hours}:{minutes:02d}:{secs:02d}"
        if hours
        else f"{minutes:02d}:{secs:02d}"
    )


class InstanceFileLock:
    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.handle = path.open("a+b")

        self.handle.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
        if self.handle.tell() == 0:
            self.handle.write(b"\0")
            self.handle.flush()

        self.handle.seek(0)
        try:
            msvcrt.locking(
                self.handle.fileno(),
                msvcrt.LK_NBLCK,
                1,
            )
        except OSError:
            self.handle.close()
            raise SystemExit(0)

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self.handle.closed:
            return

        try:
            self.handle.seek(0)
            msvcrt.locking(
                self.handle.fileno(),
                msvcrt.LK_UNLCK,
                1,
            )
        except OSError:
            pass

        self.handle.close()


class ActivityMonitor:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.instance_lock = InstanceFileLock(LOCK_PATH)

        for folder in (
            STATE_DIR,

        )
        if not re.match(r"^\d+x\d+[+-]\d+[+-]\d+$", geometry):
            geometry = "780x335+2120+267"
        self.root.geometry(geometry)

        self.build_ui()

        self.root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.hide_window)

    def write_runtime(self, state: str, message: str) -> None:

        )

    def runtime_tick(self) -> None:

    def build_ui(self) -> None:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tkinter as tk
import webbrowser
from pathlib import Path


ACS_ROOT = Path(r"~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station")
CONTINUITY_ROOT = ACS_ROOT / "ACS Continuity"
DAEMON_PATH = CONTINUITY_ROOT / "DK_ACS_CONTINUITY_DAEMON.pyw"
HANDOFF_PATH = CONTINUITY_ROOT / "DK_NEW_CHAT_HANDOFF.txt"
JSON_PATH = CONTINUITY_ROOT / "DK_ACS_CONTINUITY.json"
OSD_PATH = ACS_ROOT / "Tagged Download Auto-Runner" / "DK_TASK_RESULT_OSD.pyw"
CHATGPT_URL = "https://chatgpt.com/"


def choose_python(windowless: bool = False) -> Path:
    candidates = [
        Path(sys.executable),
        Path(
            r"~\AppData\Local\Programs"
            r"\Python\Python312\python.exe"
        ),
        Path(
            r"~\AppData\Local\Programs"
            r"\Python\Python314\python.exe"
        ),
    ]

    for item in candidates:
        if windowless:
            if item.name.lower() == "python.exe":
                pyw = item.with_name("pythonw.exe")
                if pyw.is_file():
                    return pyw
        else:
            if item.name.lower() == "pythonw.exe":
                py = item.with_name("python.exe")
                if py.is_file():
                    return py
        if item.is_file():
            return item

    return Path(sys.executable)


def refresh_snapshot() -> None:
    if not DAEMON_PATH.is_file():
        return

    subprocess.run(
        [
            str(choose_python(False)),
            str(DAEMON_PATH),
            "--snapshot",
        ],
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        timeout=45,
        creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0),
        check=False,
    )


def copy_to_clipboard(text: str) -> None:
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.withdraw()
    root.clipboard_clear()
    root.clipboard_append(text)
    root.update()
    root.destroy()


def show_osd(title: str, message: str) -> None:
    if not OSD_PATH.is_file():
        return

    pythonw = choose_python(True)
    try:
        subprocess.Popen(
            [
                str(pythonw),
                str(OSD_PATH),
                "--status",
                "SUCCESS",
                "--title",
                title,
                "--message",
                message,
                "--report",
                str(HANDOFF_PATH),
            ],
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            creationflags=(
                getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
                | getattr(subprocess, "DETACHED_PROCESS", 0)
                | getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0)
            ),
            close_fds=True,
        )
    except OSError:
        pass


def main() -> int:
    refresh_snapshot()

    if HANDOFF_PATH.is_file():
        handoff = HANDOFF_PATH.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
        )
    else:
        handoff = (
            "DK RESUME ACS\n\n"
            "Load DK_ACS_CONTINUITY.json from the connected Google Drive "
            "folder DK_ACS_REMOTE_CONTROL/Continuity."
        )

    copy_to_clipboard(handoff)
    webbrowser.open_new_tab(CHATGPT_URL)

    show_osd(
        "New ACS chat ready",
        (
            "The latest handoff was copied to the clipboard.\n"
            "In the new chat, type: DK RESUME ACS\n"
            "Paste the handoff only if Drive retrieval is unavailable."
        ),
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

def parse_args():

    parser.add_argument("--title", default="Task completed")
    parser.add_argument("--message", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--report", default="")
    return parser.parse_args()


class ResultOSD:
    def __init__(self, args) -> None:
        self.args = args
        self.status = str(args.status).upper()
        self.report = Path(args.report) if args.report else None

        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.withdraw()
        self.root.overrideredirect(True)
        self.root.attributes("-topmost", True)

        success = self.status == "SUCCESS"
        bg = "#123821" if success else "#4a1515"
        accent = "#4ade80" if success else "#fb7185"
        title = args.title or ("Task completed" if success else "Task failed")

        frame = tk.Frame(
            self.root,
            bg=bg,
            highlightbackground=accent,
            highlightthickness=3,
        )
        frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        header = tk.Frame(frame, bg=bg)
        header.pack(fill="x", padx=16, pady=(13, 4))

        tk.Label(
            header,
            text="✓" if success else "!",
            font=("Segoe UI", 21, "bold"),
            fg=accent,
            bg=bg,
        ).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 10))

        tk.Label(
            header,
            text=title,
            font=("Segoe UI Semibold", 16),
            fg="#ffffff",
            bg=bg,
            anchor="w",
        ).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)

        tk.Button(
            header,
            text="×",
            command=self.root.destroy,
            font=("Segoe UI", 13, "bold"),
            fg="#ffffff",
            bg=bg,
            activebackground=bg,
            activeforeground="#ffffff",
            bd=0,
            relief="flat",
        ).pack(side="right")

        tk.Label(
            frame,
            text=args.message,
            font=("Segoe UI", 12),
            fg="#f4f7f5",
            bg=bg,
            justify="left",
            anchor="w",
            wraplength=420,
        ).pack(fill="x", padx=16, pady=(2, 10))

        footer_text = (
            "Click to open the full report."
            if self.report and self.report.is_file()
            else "The result was recorded."
        )
        footer = tk.Label(
            frame,
            text=footer_text,
            font=("Segoe UI", 10),
            fg="#cbd5d1",
            bg=bg,
            cursor="hand2" if self.report and self.report.is_file() else "",
            anchor="w",
        )
        footer.pack(fill="x", padx=16, pady=(0, 13))

        if self.report and self.report.is_file():
            for widget in (frame, footer):
                widget.bind("<Button-1>", self.open_report)

        self.root.update_idletasks()
        width = max(460, self.root.winfo_reqwidth())
        height = max(170, self.root.winfo_reqheight())

        screen_w = self.root.winfo_screenwidth()
        screen_h = self.root.winfo_screenheight()
        x = screen_w - width - 28
        y = screen_h - height - 72
        self.root.geometry(f"{width}x{height}+{x}+{y}")

        self.root.after(100, self.show_without_focus)
        self.root.after(9000 if success else 15000, self.root.destroy)

    def show_without_focus(self) -> None:
        self.root.update_idletasks()
        hwnd = self.root.winfo_id()
        self.root.deiconify()

        SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE = 4
        HWND_TOPMOST = -1
        SWP_NOMOVE = 0x0002
        SWP_NOSIZE = 0x0001
        SWP_NOACTIVATE = 0x0010
        SWP_SHOWWINDOW = 0x0040

        try:
            ctypes.windll.user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE)
            ctypes.windll.user32.SetWindowPos(
                hwnd,
                HWND_TOPMOST,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW,
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    def open_report(self, _event=None) -> None:
        if self.report and self.report.is_file():
            os.startfile(str(self.report))
        self.root.destroy()

    def run(self) -> None:
        self.root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ResultOSD(parse_args()).run()

CONFIG_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(__file__)), "recorder_config.json")

DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    "monitor_index": 4, 
    "crop_x": 0,
    "crop_y": 0,
    "crop_w": 1280,
    "crop_h": 720,
    "output_dir": r"G:\My Drive\Nest Cam",
    "fps": 60,
    "start_on_boot": False,
    "recording_enabled": True,
    "indicator_x": None,
    "indicator_y": None,
    "position_locked": False,
    "status_text": "Nest Camera"
}

class ContinuousRecorderApp:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.load_config()
        
        self.is_recording = False
        self.record_thread = None
        self.drag_data = {"x": 0, "y": 0}
        self.using_ffmpeg = False

        self.root.overrideredirect(True)
        self.root.attributes("-topmost", True)
        self.root.configure(bg="#0d0d0d")
        
        self.label = Label(
            self.root, 
            text=self.config["status_text"], 
            fg="#00ffcc", 
            bg="#0d0d0d", 
            font=("Consolas", 11, "bold"),
            padx=10, 
            pady=5,
            bd=1,
            relief="solid",
            highlightbackground="#333333"
        )
        self.label.pack()

        self.update_indicator_status()

        if self.config["indicator_x"] is not None and self.config["indicator_y"] is not None:
            self.root.geometry(f"+{self.config['indicator_x']}+{self.config['indicator_y']}")
        else:
            self.root.update_idletasks()
            w = self.root.winfo_width()
            h = self.root.winfo_height()
            x = (self.root.winfo_screenwidth() // 2) - (w // 2)
            y = (self.root.winfo_screenheight() // 2) - (h // 2)
            self.root.geometry(f"+{x}+{y}")

        self.label.bind("<Button-1>", self.start_drag)
        self.label.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.drag)
        self.label.bind("<Button-3>", self.show_context_menu)

        self.menu = Menu(self.root, tearoff=0, bg="#1a1a1a", fg="#ffffff", activebackground="#00ffcc", activeforeground="#000000", bd=0)
        self.update_context_menu_labels()

        keyboard.add_hotkey('ctrl+shift+x', lambda: self.root.after(0, self.terminate_app))

        self.manage_recording_state()

    def load_config(self):
        if os.path.exists(CONFIG_FILE):
            try:
                with open(CONFIG_FILE, "r") as f:
                    self.config = json.load(f)
                    for k, v in DEFAULT_CONFIG.items():
                        if k not in self.config:
                            self.config[k] = v
            except:
                self.config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy()
        else:
            self.config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy()

    def save_config(self):
        try:
            with open(CONFIG_FILE, "w") as f:
                json.dump(self.config, f, indent=4)
        except Exception as e:
            pass

    def update_context_menu_labels(self):
        self.menu.delete(0, "end")
        lock_label = "Unlock Position" if self.config["position_locked"] else "Lock Position"
        self.menu.add_command(label=lock_label, command=self.toggle_position_lock)
        
        rec_label = "Disable Recording" if self.config["recording_enabled"] else "Enable Recording"
        self.menu.add_command(label=rec_label, command=self.toggle_recording_enabled)
        
        self.menu.add_command(label="Settings Panel", command=self.open_settings)
        self.menu.add_separator()
        self.menu.add_command(label="Exit Application", command=self.terminate_app)

    def update_indicator_status(self):
        # Removed the [GPU] tag addition
        if self.config["recording_enabled"] and self.is_recording:
            self.label.configure(text=self.config["status_text"], highlightcolor="#ff3333", highlightbackground="#ff3333", fg="#ff3333")
        else:
            self.label.configure(text=self.config["status_text"], highlightcolor="#00ff66", highlightbackground="#00ff66", fg="#00ff66")

    def set_waiting_status(self):
        self.label.configure(
            text=f"Waiting for Monitor {self.config['monitor_index']}...", 
            highlightcolor="#ffaa00", 
            highlightbackground="#ffaa00", 
            fg="#ffaa00"
        )

    # --- NEW: Drive Missing Status ---
    def set_path_error_status(self):
        self.label.configure(
            text="Drive Disconnected!", 
            highlightcolor="#ffaa00", 
            highlightbackground="#ffaa00", 
            fg="#ffaa00"
        )
    # ---------------------------------

    def start_drag(self, event):
        if not self.config["position_locked"]:
            self.drag_data["x"] = event.x
            self.drag_data["y"] = event.y

    def drag(self, event):

scripts.content:
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CONFIG = HERE / "DK_ACS_SILENT_BOOT_CONFIG.json"
LOG = HERE / "DK_ACS_SILENT_BOOT.log"
CREATE_NO_WINDOW = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)

kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
_mutex = kernel32.CreateMutexW(
    None, False, r"Global\DK_ACS_SILENT_BOOT_CONTROLLER_V4"
)
if kernel32.GetLastError() == 183:
    sys.exit(0)


def log(message: str) -> None:
    try:
        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(f"[{stamp}] {message}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def load_config() -> dict:
    with CONFIG.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return json.load(handle)


def run_hidden(args: list[str]) -> None:
    try:
        subprocess.Popen(
            args,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
            close_fds=True,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        log(f"Launch failed: {args} | {exc}")


def command_line_contains(path: Path) -> bool:
    escaped = str(path).replace("'", "''")
    ps = (
        "$p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | "
        "Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and "
        f"$_.CommandLine -like '*{escaped}*' "
        "} | Select-Object -First 1; "
        "if ($p) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"
    )

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [
                "powershell.exe",
                "-NoProfile",
                "-NonInteractive",
                "-WindowStyle",
                "Hidden",
                "-Command",
                ps,
            ],
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
            timeout=15,
            check=False,
        )
        return result.returncode == 0
    except Exception:
        return False


def start_python_target(
    pythonw: Path,
    target: Path,
    extra_args: list[str] | None = None,
) -> None:
    if not target.is_file():
        log(f"Target missing: {target}")
        return

    if command_line_contains(target):
        return

    args = [str(pythonw), str(target)]
    if extra_args:
        args.extend(extra_args)

    run_hidden(args)
    log(f"Started: {target}")


def start_acs_once(config: dict) -> None:
    for item in config.get("acs_launchers", []):
        launcher = Path(item)
        if not launcher.is_file():
            continue

        suffix = launcher.suffix.lower()

        if suffix == ".vbs":
            run_hidden(
                [
                    str(
                        Path(
                            os.environ.get(
                                "SystemRoot", r"C:\Windows"
                            )
                        )
                        / "System32"
                        / "wscript.exe"
                    ),
                    "//B",
                    "//Nologo",
                    str(launcher),
                ]
            )
        elif suffix in {".bat", ".cmd"}:
            run_hidden(
                [
                    str(
                        Path(
                            os.environ.get(
                                "SystemRoot", r"C:\Windows"
                            )
                        )
                        / "System32"
                        / "cmd.exe"
                    ),
                    "/d",
                    "/c",
                    str(launcher),
                ]
            )
        else:
            run_hidden([str(launcher)])

        log(f"ACS launch requested: {launcher}")
        return

    log("No existing ACS silent launcher was found.")


def main() -> None:
    time.sleep(4.0)
    config = load_config()
    pythonw = Path(config["pythonw"])

    # Start ACS once. Its own existing dot/status interface remains in charge.
    start_acs_once(config)
    time.sleep(2.0)

    scheduler = Path(config["scheduler"])
    adb_keeper_text = config.get("adb_keeper", "")
    adb_keeper = Path(adb_keeper_text) if adb_keeper_text else None

    # Remain hidden and act as a watchdog.
    while True:
        try:
            start_python_target(pythonw, scheduler)

            if adb_keeper is not None:
                start_python_target(
                    pythonw,
                    adb_keeper,
                    ["--hidden"],
                )

            time.sleep(45.0)

        except Exception as exc:
            log(f"Watchdog error: {exc}")
            time.sleep(15.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

﻿from __future__ import annotations
import base64, json, os, sqlite3, ssl, sys, urllib.parse, urllib.request, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

UP = Path(os.environ.get("USERPROFILE", str(Path.home())))
ACS = UP / "Desktop" / "Automation Creation Station"
PLUGIN = ACS / "Plugins" / "DK WebDAV Library Bridge"
DATABASE = PLUGIN / "database"
EXPORTS = PLUGIN / "exports"
REPORTS = PLUGIN / "reports"
LOGS = PLUGIN / "logs"
CONFIG = ACS / "config" / "dk_webdav_library_bridge_config.json"
SECRET = ***
DB = DATABASE / "webdav_library.sqlite"
LATEST = PLUGIN / "latest_webdav_library_report.txt"
BRAIN_INBOX = ACS / "Brain State" / "goals" / "inbox"

VIDEO_EXT = {".mkv",".mp4",".avi",".mov",".wmv",".m4v",".ts",".webm",".mpg",".mpeg",".3gp",".flv"}
AUDIO_EXT = {".mp3",".flac",".wav",".aac",".m4a",".ogg",".opus",".wma"}
SUB_EXT = {".srt",".ass",".ssa",".vtt",".sub"}
PLAYLIST_EXT = {".m3u",".m3u8",".pls"}
MEDIA_EXT = VIDEO_EXT | AUDIO_EXT | SUB_EXT | PLAYLIST_EXT

def now(): return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
def stamp(): return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
def write(p: Path, t: str):
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(t, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
def ensure():
    for d in [PLUGIN,DATABASE,EXPORTS,REPORTS,LOGS,BRAIN_INBOX]:
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not CONFIG.exists():
        write(CONFIG, json.dumps(default_config(), indent=2))
def log(msg):
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (LOGS/"webdav_library_bridge.log").open("a",encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"{now()}  {msg}\n")

def default_config():
    return {
        "enabled": True,
        "mode": "direct_webdav",
        "direct_webdav": {
            "base_url": "",
            "root_path": "/",
            "username": "",
            "password": "",
            "timeout_seconds": 30,
            "max_depth": 3,
            "verify_ssl": True
        },
        "mounted_folder": {
            "path": "",
            "max_depth": 6
        },
        "include_only_media_files": False,
        "exclude_folder_terms": ["$RECYCLE.BIN", "System Volume Information", ".git", "__pycache__"],
        "safety_note": "Indexes WebDAV or mounted folders only. Does not download, stream, or bypass access controls."
    }

def cfg():
    ensure()
    c = default_config()
    try:
        disk = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
        for k,v in disk.items():
            if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(c.get(k), dict):
                c[k].update(v)
            else:
                c[k] = v
    except Exception:
        pass
    if SECRET.exists():
        try:
            s = json.loads(SECRET.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
            dw = c.setdefault("direct_webdav", {})
            for k in ["base_url","username","password","root_path"]:
                if s.get(k): dw[k] = s.get(k)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return c

def conn():
    ensure()
    c=sqlite3.connect(DB)
    c.execute("""create table if not exists items(
        id integer primary key autoincrement,
        source text,
        path text,
        name text,
        url text,
        is_dir integer,
        size integer,
        modified text,
        ext text,
        category text,
        indexed_at text
    )""")
    c.execute("create index if not exists idx_items_path on items(path)")
    c.execute("create index if not exists idx_items_name on items(name)")
    c.commit()
    return c

def reset_db(source):
    c=conn()
    c.execute("delete from items where source=?",(source,))
    c.commit()
    c.close()

def add_item(source,path,name,url,is_dir,size,modified):
    ext=Path(name).suffix.lower()
    category="folder" if is_dir else ("video" if ext in VIDEO_EXT else "audio" if ext in AUDIO_EXT else "subtitle" if ext in SUB_EXT else "playlist" if ext in PLAYLIST_EXT else "other")
    c=conn()
    c.execute("""insert into items(source,path,name,url,is_dir,size,modified,ext,category,indexed_at)
                 values(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)""",(source,path,name,url,1 if is_dir else 0,int(size or 0),modified or "",ext,category,now()))
    c.commit()
    c.close()

def excluded(path, config):
    low=path.lower()
    for term in config.get("exclude_folder_terms",[]):
        if str(term).lower() in low: return True
    return False

def auth_header(username,password):
    if not username and not password: ***
    raw=(username+":"+password).encode("utf-8")
    return {"Authorization":"Basic "+base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")}

def join_url(base, href):
    return urllib.parse.urljoin(base.rstrip("/")+"/", href.lstrip("/"))

def webdav_propfind(url, username, password, timeout, verify_ssl):
    xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?><D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:prop><D:displayname/><D:getcontentlength/><D:getlastmodified/><D:resourcetype/></D:prop></D:propfind>'
    req=urllib.request.Request(url, data=xml.encode("utf-8"), method="PROPFIND")
    req.add_header("Depth","1")
    req.add_header("Content-Type","text/xml; charset=utf-8")
    for k,v in auth_header(username,password).items(): req.add_header(k,v)
    ctx=None if verify_ssl else ssl._create_unverified_context()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout, context=ctx) as r:
        return r.read()

def parse_multistatus(xml_bytes, base_url):
    ns={"d":"DAV:"}
    root=ET.fromstring(xml_bytes)
    out=[]
    for resp in root.findall(".//d:response",ns):
        href_el=resp.find("d:href",ns)
        if href_el is None or not href_el.text: continue
        href=urllib.parse.unquote(href_el.text)
        props=resp.find(".//d:prop",ns)
        name=""
        size=0
        mod=""
        is_dir=False
        if props is not None:
            dn=props.find("d:displayname",ns)
            if dn is not None and dn.text: name=dn.text
            cl=props.find("d:getcontentlength",ns)
            if cl is not None and cl.text and cl.text.isdigit(): size=int(cl.text)
            lm=props.find("d:getlastmodified",ns)
            if lm is not None and lm.text: mod=lm.text
            rt=props.find("d:resourcetype",ns)
            if rt is not None and rt.find("d:collection",ns) is not None: is_dir=True
        if not name:
            name=Path(href.rstrip("/")).name
        out.append({"href":href,"name":name,"url":join_url(base_url,href),"is_dir":is_dir,"size":size,"modified":mod})
    return out

def scan_webdav():
    c=cfg(); d=c["direct_webdav"]
    base=d.get("base_url","").strip()
    if not base: return {"ok":False,"message":"base_url is blank. Run 01_SET_DIRECT_WEBDAV_CONFIG.bat first."}
    root=d.get("root_path","/") or "/"
    start=join_url(base,root)
    max_depth=int(d.get("max_depth",3))
    timeout=int(d.get("timeout_seconds",30))
    verify=bool(d.get("verify_ssl",True))
    user=d.get("username","")
    pw=d.get("password","")
    source="direct_webdav"
    reset_db(source)
    seen=set()
    stack=[(start,0)]
    folders=files=0
    while stack:
        url,depth=stack.pop()
        if url in seen or depth>max_depth: continue
        seen.add(url)
        if excluded(url,c): continue
        try:
            rows=parse_multistatus(webdav_propfind(url,user,pw,timeout,verify),base)
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"PROPFIND failed {url}: {e}")
            continue
        for r in rows:
            ru=r["url"]
            if ru.rstrip("/") == url.rstrip("/"): continue
            if excluded(ru,c): continue
            name=r["name"]
            ext=Path(name).suffix.lower()
            if c.get("include_only_media_files",False) and (not r["is_dir"]) and ext not in MEDIA_EXT:
                continue
            path=urllib.parse.urlparse(ru).path
            add_item(source,path,name,ru,r["is_dir"],r["size"],r["modified"])
            if r["is_dir"]:
                folder
