scripts.description: ADB_Keeper_v1.pyw
scripts.preview:
# ADB_Keeper_v1.pyw
# Put this file here:
# ~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station\Nexus Automation Station\ADB_Keeper_v1.pyw
#
# Reads:
scripts.content:
# ADB_Keeper_v1.pyw
# Put this file here:
# ~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station\Nexus Automation Station\ADB_Keeper_v1.pyw
#
# Reads:
# ~\Desktop\Automation Creation Station\Nexus Automation Station\config\devices.json
#
# Keeps ADB devices connected using reserved router IPs and port 5555.

import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import queue
import subprocess
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox

APP_NAME = "ADB Keeper v1"

DESKTOP = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Desktop")
ROOT = os.path.join(DESKTOP, "Automation Creation Station")
NEXUS = os.path.join(ROOT, "Nexus Automation Station")
CONFIG = os.path.join(NEXUS, "config")
LOGS = os.path.join(NEXUS, "logs")
DEVICES_JSON = os.path.join(CONFIG, "devices.json")
LOG_FILE = os.path.join(LOGS, "adb_keeper.log")

BG = "#050505"
PANEL = "#0b1110"
INPUT = "#07100d"
GREEN = "#00ff88"
BLUE = "#00ccff"
YELLOW = "#ffd166"
RED = "#ff3366"
TEXT = "#eafff7"
MUTED = "#7ccfbd"
BORDER = "#063b2b"


def ensure_dirs():
    os.makedirs(CONFIG, exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(LOGS, exist_ok=True)


def stamp():
    return dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def file_log(msg):
    try:
        with open(LOG_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"[{stamp()}] {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def default_devices():
    return {
        "devices": {
            "Jack-s-A16": {
                "type": "android",
                "ip": "192.168.1.169",
                "port": 5555,
                "adb_serial": "192.168.1.169:5555",
                "role": "Android automation phone",
                "enabled": True
            }
        }
    }


def load_devices():
    ensure_dirs()
    if not os.path.exists(DEVICES_JSON):
        with open(DEVICES_JSON, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(default_devices(), f, indent=2)
    try:
        with open(DEVICES_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or "devices" not in data:
            return default_devices()
        return data
    except Exception as e:
        file_log(f"devices.json load failed: {e}")
        return default_devices()


def find_adb():
    if os.path.exists(r"C:\adb\adb.exe"):
        return r"C:\adb\adb.exe"
    return "adb"


class ADBKeeper:
    def __init__(self):
        ensure_dirs()
        self.adb = find_adb()
        self.devices_data = load_devices()
        self.running = True
        self.device_status = {}
        self.log_q = queue.Queue()

        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title(APP_NAME)
        self.root.geometry("860x600+140+100")
        self.root.configure(bg=BG)
        self.root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.hide_main)

        self.auto_reconnect = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        self.check_seconds = tk.StringVar(value="10")

        self.build_ui()
        self.create_dot()

        self.log(f"ADB Keeper started. ADB = {self.adb}")
        self.refresh_device_list()

        self.root.after(200, self.drain_log)
        threading.Thread(target=self.watch_loop, daemon=True).start()

    def log(self, msg):
        line = f"[{stamp()}] {msg}"
        file_log(msg)
        self.log_q.put(line)

    def drain_log(self):
        try:
            while True:
                line = self.log_q.get_nowait()
                self.log_box.insert("end", line + "\n")
                self.log_box.see("end")
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        if self.running:
            self.root.after(200, self.drain_log)

    def btn(self, parent, text, command, danger=False):
        return tk.Button(
            parent,
            text=text,
            command=command,
            bg="#7a2525" if danger else BG,
            fg="#ffffff" if danger else GREEN,
            activebackground="#5c1c1c" if danger else "#0d1f1a",
            activeforeground="#ffffff",
            relief="flat",
            bd=0,
            padx=10,
            pady=6,
            font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"),
            cursor="hand2"
        )

    def build_ui(self):
        header = tk.Frame(self.root, bg=BG)
        header.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=(12, 6))
        tk.Label(header, text="ADB KEEPER", bg=BG, fg=GREEN, font=("Segoe UI", 16, "bold")).pack(side="left")
        tk.Label(header, text="static IP + port 5555 watchdog", bg=BG, fg=MUTED, font=("Consolas", 10)).pack(side="left", padx=12)

        row = tk.Frame(self.root, bg=BG)
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=6)
        self.btn(row, "Reload devices.json", self.reload_devices).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        self.btn(row, "Connect Selected", self.connect_selected).pack(side="left", padx=4)

        self.dot_canvas.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.dot_circle = self.dot_canvas.create_oval(6, 6, 22, 22, fill=GREEN, outline="#003322", width=2)

        self.dot.bind("<Button-1>", lambda e: self.show_main())

scripts.content:
@echo off

:: Wait for 180 seconds (3 minutes) before starting
echo Waiting 3 minutes for system to stabilize...
timeout /t 180 /nobreak

:: Ensure the script runs with Administrator privileges 
net session >nul 2>&1 
if %errorLevel% == 0 ( 
    echo [1/2] Starting ATB/ADB Services... 
    :: Replace 'Service1' with your specific ATB service name 
    net start "Service1" 
    
    echo [2/2] Setting ports to 5555... 
    :: This command tells ADB to listen for connections on port 5555 
    adb tcpip 5555 
    
    echo. 
    echo All operations completed successfully. 
) else ( 
    echo Error: Please right-click and 'Run as Administrator'. 
    pause 
)
